State-level Voting Rights Acts -- like this one in Michigan, or Minnesota's recent law -- are models for other states across the country and exactly the type of pro-voter legislation we need to protect our right to vote everywhere.
Team: Fuel our efforts to support bills like this around the country with $25 or more right now >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=073124_4&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=073124_4&amount=25]
9 & 10 News: Michigan Voting Rights Act advances out of committee [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=073124_4&amount=25]
Team: The Michigan Voting Rights Act is making good progress toward becoming law. This bill would:
➜ Guarantees in state law protections previously afforded under the 1965 federal Voting Rights Act.
➜ Establishes a nonpartisan election information database.
➜ Requires some local governments to provide alternate language voting materials.
➜ Allows for curbside voting and other assistive services for disabled voters.
This package of bills will reinforce Michigan’s election system and provide clear pathways for those who feel their voting rights are being infringed to right the wrongs that may have stopped them from voting.
Remember: The recent 8th Federal Circuit Court ruling is one of the most dangerous anti-voter rulings we’ve seen in years . In the eight states impacted by the ruling, voters and voting rights organizations can no longer sue to overturn unjust laws under the Voting Rights Act.
These new laws, if passed in Michigan, would restore those protections and codify them into state law, regardless of how the Supreme Court eventually rules.
Team: We need to pass these bills in Michigan and expand this movement to other states around the country. body:
IR’s Editor-in-Chief Mark Vargas covered the National Association of Black Journalists panel discussion today in Chicago, which Pres. Trump attended.

view in browser (https://mailchi.mp/f48f72391443/exclusive-donald-trump-jr-draws-large-crowds-receives-lifetime-membership-10345575?e=1cb5fdae9e) | update preferences (https://illinoisreview.us14.list-manage.com/profile?u=811d47b3c0783e80274d515f7&id=1a5a561027&e=1cb5fdae9e&c=507edc2ccc) | unsubscribe (https://illinoisreview.us14.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=811d47b3c0783e80274d515f7&id=1a5a561027&t=b&e=1cb5fdae9e&c=507edc2ccc)

This IR e-Blast Powered By:
https://www.bestdental.org/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=507edc2ccc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to read this BREAKING news from Illinois Review, the largest conservative media source in Illinois, and the only source that has been shared by President Donald Trump.
Nat’l Assoc. of Black Journalists Moderators Disrespect Trump, Working Class Voters During Chicago Panel Discussion as VP Harris Snubs Convention (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/natl-assoc-of-black-journalists-moderators-disrespect-trump-working-class-voters-during-chicago-panel-discussion-as-vp-harris-snubs-convention.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=507edc2ccc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/natl-assoc-of-black-journalists-moderators-disrespect-trump-working-class-voters-during-chicago-panel-discussion-as-vp-harris-snubs-convention.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=507edc2ccc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
President Donald Trump speaks during a hostile discussion with biased moderators during the annaul NABJ conference in Chicago on July 31, 2024. (Mark Vargas/Illinois Review)
By Illinois Review

On Wednesday, President Donald Trump joined the National Association of Black Journalists during their annual convention in Chicago for a moderated discussion about the “the most pressing issues facing the Black community,” just days after Vice President Kamala Harris’ campaign told the 4,000 member organization that she was too busy to make an appearance at the 5-day convention and career fair.

The discussion, moderated by ABC News’ Rachel Scott, Fox News anchor Harris Faulkner and Semafor political reporter Kadia Goba, presented Trump with an opportunity to speak directly to the Black community, but right out of the gate, Scott attacked the former president with the first question, prompting the Republican nominee to respond with,

“I don’t think I’ve ever been asked a question in such a horrible manner, first question. You don’t even say ‘Hello, how are you?’ Are you with ABC? Because I think they are a fake news network, a terrible network.”
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/natl-assoc-of-black-journalists-moderators-disrespect-trump-working-class-voters-during-chicago-panel-discussion-as-vp-harris-snubs-convention.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=507edc2ccc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
The hostility on stage coming from Scott and Goba towards the popular former president who leads in polls against Vice President Harris, was a disservice to the attendees and the community at large who wanted to hear from Trump about his plans to improve a community plagued by violent crime, a migrant crisis and poverty.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/natl-assoc-of-black-journalists-moderators-disrespect-trump-working-class-voters-during-chicago-panel-discussion-as-vp-harris-snubs-convention.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=507edc2ccc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
President Donald Trump speaks during the NABJ annual conference in Chicago on July 31, 2024. (Mark Vargas/Illinois Review)
Beginning with the first question, it was clear that Faulker’s fellow moderators wanted to use the opportunity with Trump to showcase their political biases, instead of engaging in a productive conversation about important policy issues – proving to the rest of the country once again, why the mainstream media can’t be trusted.

The highly anticipated panel discussion was expected to focus on key policy issues, but the biased moderators chose to attack Trump and deny voters an opportunity to hear directly from him about crises that are destroying lives and livelihoods in urban communities throughout the country.

“I have been the best president for the Black population since Abraham Lincoln,” Trump told a crowd of about 1,500 people. And he has the receipts to back that up. During Trump’s presidency, his economic policies led to the lowest unemployment rate in the Black community in history. In August of 2019, the U.S. Department of Labor
reported (https://www.cnn.com/2019/09/06/economy/black-unemployment-rate/index.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=507edc2ccc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) that the unemployment rate for Black workers dropped to 5.5 percent, and the unemployment rate for Black women dropped to 4.4 percent – marking historic lows.

In 2019, the U.S. Congress – at President Trump’s urging, passed the First Step Act, which he signed – that made sweeping changes to the broken and racist criminal justice system put in place by Democrats in the 1990s and reversed, among other things, excessive sentencing policies for non-violent first-time offenders – many of them Black men and women who were serving unfair and inhumanely long prison sentences as non-violent offenders.

Then U.S. Sen. Joe Biden, chairman of the Senate Judiciary Committee, authored the bill that accelerated mass incarceration for Black Americans known as the 1994 Crime bill that President Bill Clinton signed into law. And it’s what author
Michelle Alexander (https://newjimcrow.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=507edc2ccc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) referred to as “The New Jim Crow” in America. And the First Step Act, which President Trump championed and signed into law, helped reverse the policies put forth and passed by an overwhelming majority of Democratic politicians in the mid 1990s.

After President Trump signed the historic criminal justice reform legislation, U.S. Sen. Dick Durbin (D-IL), the number two Democrat in the Senate, gave a media interview and
apologized (https://www.politico.com/story/2019/06/21/durbin-tough-on-crime-bill-1376697?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=507edc2ccc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) for his support of the 1994 crime bill, calling it “the worst vote I ever gave.”

Over the July 4th holiday weekend in Chicago, where the conference was held, gang violence terrorized residents in the Democratic-controlled city as 100 people were shot, 17 fatally – turning scenes of celebrations into scenes of chaos, death and carnage.

Last year, over
225,000 high priority (https://wirepoints.org/225000-priority-911-calls-in-chicago-go-unanswered-so-far-in-2023-wirepoints/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=507edc2ccc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) 911 calls went unanswered because of a police officer shortage – leaving residents and visitors in grave danger. It’s been reported by several local news outlets and law enforcement experts that Chicago is short nearly 2,000 police officers, creating a nightmare scenario for officials who are trying to convince the country that Chicago is safe enough to host the country’s top Democratic leaders including the ailing and aging president of the United States.

And it’s been reported that Chicago – a sanctuary city – has seen an
11,000 percent (https://www.fairus.org/blog/2023/12/01/sanctuary-city-chicago-sees-11000-increase-arrests-venezuelans-border-crisis-began?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=507edc2ccc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) increase in arrests of Venezuelan migrants since President Joe Biden opened up our southern border. It’s estimated that over 20,000 migrants have arrived in Chicago in the last year, costing more than $400 million – with 25 buses arriving each day dropping off an average of 1,250 migrants around the city and various surrounding communities.

And while many had hoped to hear more about Trump’s plans to curb violence, close our southern border and improve economic conditions – Thursday’s moderators wanted to score political points and attack the former president instead of talking about issues that matter most to voters in November – especially residents in the Black community.

Immediately after the event, Trump posted a message on his Truth Social that read, “The questions were RUDE and Nasty, often in the form of a statement, but we CRUSHED IT!”

I started a business, and I’m a proud job creator, employing more than 1,000 hard-working people.

As an entrepreneur, I have the responsibility of making a payroll every two weeks and know that our team’s car payments, rent, and mortgages depend on all of us effectively doing our jobs. And We’ve been growing successfully, doing that for 35 years.

Here is the thing: America is the land of opportunity, and that starts with a strong economy. _The best social program is a job._

Yet too many families are struggling to pay their mortgages, buy groceries, and put gas in their cars. **In New Jersey, we pay the highest taxes in the nation yet receive only 75 cents back on the dollar from the federal government.**

Our families cannot afford to elect another selfish, so-called _"leader"_ who cares more about their own political ambitions than coming up with sensible solutions that actually help law-abiding American citizens. _**We deserve better than this.**_

**However, fundraising numbers historically drop to an all-time low in the summer months, but with Kamala’s recent small-dollar haul, we can’t afford to let our foot off the pedal.**

Before the month is up at midnight, [**can I count on you to step forward with a donation so that we can stop the status quo?**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=8e6e8fa7c3ce45839b551c41daa38783&_e=O6HrMcvCh0O9ZrPUre4PkaBwnY-F_TsCFrSOhPjY9-miDN4_nzzxLA5L87vk6EjHlXDuD8mUm7SMVF1jALOqq2YgYkF13PmiQsF7GtgqRKUWvCEvznzrcwryVAgnYaPDR5I0HYcy83h6reOnq_a6JNMZH8Mf2Uz2frFnwG3oOkSEWKmYueAhaAjFbLAanOHcOKlhP7aBtqD2JbmQBxgQNg0zDZZJRbxITbacpTEeioLKtmSFfVlzyHzHInqTvuniMPBb41LN6qhqIkpvgwC6z9kvblCRutZVWxPQKXfsU352BoOxl0leLS-ZpC9qi0aq0ti0cNs5KLSV9-ouDxSUpjMrJMOgsdFnj6_eMA8tLi--Nvmy9kXbKZYV7rtHorSZ4e03rFgyCwdTzNDcZRI8DCGkuwGz0ylg63jchLtLBPg%3D)

clean_body: We are in real contention to win a governing trifecta this November. | | | | Earlier this year, Ron wrote to you about the state of play this November. And now, as Democrats are experiencing a surge of new momentum, his message couldn't be more important. We are in real contention to win a governing trifecta this November. It's never been more vital that we defend and expand our Democratic majority in the Senate while doing everything we can to win back power in the House. We've got the opportunity to reclaim control of the House by flipping just fourseats — and one of the closest races is right here in Oregon. = Just imagine:if we hold the White House and earn a Democratic "trifecta," that wouldn't just enable us to maintain our progressive wins but buildon them. Democrats promised big, bold action on the challenges facing Oregonians and Americans across the country, and we've come a long way in delivering. We've lowered drug prices, and energy costs and expanded investment in our nation's crumbling infrastructure. Meanwhile, Republicans want to drag our country backward. Instead of more MAGA-manufactured chaos in the halls of Congress or the looming threats of Trump and his MAGA cronies — we could make real progress on issues like the housing crisis, education, job creation, civil liberties, the climate crisis, and beyond. = Team Wyden Donate Now If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | = | = ---|--- = | = = \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Ron Wyden <campaign@wydenforsenate.com> Date: Thu, Mar 30, 2024 at 1:16 PM Subject: Why this moment matters: To: I'll be upfront about the playing field for control of Congress in 2024: Democrats are on offense in the battle for control of the House and can re-take it by flipping just 4 seats in districts that Joe Biden carried by significant margins However, we face a historically daunting Senate map and need to hold seats in 5 states that each voted at least once for Donald Trump = Our Democratic Senate majority has a lot to be proud of — from confirming hundreds of progressive judges to passing historic legislation to create jobs, boost clean energy, and bring down the cost of prescription drugs. The chances of further progress will disappear if Republicans flip the chamber this November –but if we holdthe Senate (and re-take the House), the possibilities for what the next Democratic trifecta could accomplish are historic. We could secure civil liberties and voting rights. We could create a wave of affordable housing. We could fix the damage wrought by the right-wing Supreme Court. We could expand health care access, and make higher education an achievable reality for all Americans. A strong, progressive government has a tremendous ability to do good for the American people. We've seen that in everything from our infrastructure law to our COVID relief efforts to the CHIPS Act to the Inflation Reduction Act. If we hold the majority come 2025, there is so much more we can do to build on our progress. But first, we have to pull out all the stops and ensure that we have the resources to counter GOP spending across the board. And that starts with putting up a strong number after tomorrow night's FEC deadline. I will always be on the side of progress and justice, and I'm glad that folks like you are part of our movement. Together, our grassroots power can counter the influence of big money and ensure that a people-driven agenda prevails. = Onward, Ron | | Paid for and authorized by Wyden for Senate. | This email was sent by Wyden for Senate P.O. Friend,
In a few short hours, we’ll meet our July fundraising deadline.
Kamala just announced that she raised over $250 million from liberal billionaires, so if we’re going to keep our momentum running strong, we must hit our goal by midnight.
__I’m going to ask you for $5 to help us get there, but before I do, let me tell you what $5 means to me.__
I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio.
Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our “leaders” in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind.

name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: COMING SOON: Vote to help TOP host a panel at SXSW 2025 / SE ACERCA PRONTO: Vote para ayudar a TOP a organizar un panel en SXSW 2025
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Vote next week to help get TOP to the SXSW 2025 panel stage
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/SXSW%20sign.jpg]
We’re proud to share that TOP has submitted a panel proposal for SXSW 2025 — "Art & Culture as Catalysts for Progress Movement Building," featuring rapper and activist Tef Poe [https://www.berklee.edu/people/tef-poe] !
We know that key in our efforts to build a democracy in Texas that looks like us and shares our values, our ideas have to inpsire change and be creatively shared. Being selected to participate in SXSW 2025 is one way we see shaping the larger cultural conversation about civic engagement.
Community voting for SXSW panel proposals starts this coming Tuesday, August 6, and runs through August 18.
STAY TUNED: Next week, we'll show you how to create a free, simple account to vote for our proposal on SXSW’s PanelPicker platform!
SIGN THE PETITION:
Call on local leaders in Harris County to build a resilient local energy hub
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Power%20Up%20Harris%20County.png]
Harris County residents are drained and frustrated — and rightfully so. Two months ago, the 100 mph winds of the Derecho took seven lives and left over a million of us without power. Then, Hurricane Beryl hit, claiming the lives of over 30 people and cutting power for over 2 million in the area. Imagine how much worse it would have been had Beryl been a stronger, Category 5 storm.
Right-wing politicians at the Texas Capitol continue to fail us — caring more about waging culture wars and scoring cheap political points against Houston leaders than keeping us safe. It’s time Houstonians come together to fight for real, progressive-minded solutions. We need our own local power grid, and we need it now!
That's why through the Power Up Harris County coaltion, we’re calling on our local elected officials to create a Harris County Energy Hub to give us the freedom to be ready, safe, and powered up for future storms we know are coming.
SIGN THE PETITION if you're a Harris County resident ready for the change we need. [https://actionnetwork.org/petitions/sign-the-petition-demand-local-leaders-build-a-local-energy-hub-in-harris-county/]
Joining in the celebration of the life of Congresswoman Sheila Jackson Lee
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/SJL%20passing.jpg]
TOP staff and members were honored to attend Wednesday's community farewell and appreciation service [https://www.houstonchronicle.com/politics/houston/article/wheeler-baptist-sheila-jackson-lee-19610850.php] in memory of Congresswoman Sheila Jackson Lee.
From the halls of Congress to the streets of Houston, Sheila Jackson Lee exemplified public service and leadership.
Knowledgeable and tenacious, she approached her work as a lawmaker with an unwavering commitment to justice, defending our freedoms, and improving the lives of Harris County residents. TOP is proud to have worked with Congresswoman Sheila Jackson Lee for years to address issues that matter to working Houstonians, from housing, to healthcare access, to voting rights, and more.
Our organization is grateful to have had the Congresswoman as a progressive ally in our fight for a #TXForAll, a state where all feel valued and can thrive – no matter our age, race, or gender.
We extend our heartfelt condolences to the loved ones of the Congresswoman, as well as all who she positively impacted over her more than 30 years as a public servant.
TOP Tips: Prep your family's schedule before school rolls around
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Family%20picnic.jpg]
There's still some summer break left, but if you have school-age kids, you know making adjustments to daily schedules takes time and careful prep. Refresh yourself on ways to make this process easier for you and your family before school starts up again. [https://www.care.com/c/transitioning-from-summer-back-to-school/]
Español
Vote la próxima semana para ayudar a que TOP llegue al escenario del panel de SXSW 2025
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/SXSW%20sign.jpg]
Estamos orgullosos de compartir que TOP ha presentado una propuesta de panel para SXSW 2025: Arte y cultura como catalizadores para la construcción de un movimiento de progreso, con la participación del rapero y activista Tef Poe [https://www.berklee.edu/people/tef-poe] .
Sabemos que, en nuestros esfuerzos por construir una democracia en Texas que se parezca a nosotros y comparta nuestros valores, nuestras ideas deben inspirar cambios y ser compartidas de manera creativa. Ser seleccionados para participar en SXSW 2025 es una de las formas en que vemos que podemos dar forma a la conversación cultural más amplia sobre el compromiso cívico.
La votación comunitaria para las propuestas de paneles de SXSW comienza el próximo martes 6 de agosto y se extenderá hasta el 18 de agosto.
ESTÉN ATENTOS: la próxima semana, les mostraremos cómo crear una cuenta gratuita y sencilla para votar por nuestra propuesta en la plataforma PanelPicker de SXSW.
FIRMA LA PETICIÓN:
Haz un llamado a los líderes locales del condado de Harris para que construyan un centro de energía local resiliente
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Power%20Up%20Harris%20County.png]
Los residentes del condado de Harris están agotados y frustrados, y con razón. Hace dos meses, los vientos de 100 mph de Derecho cobraron siete vidas y dejaron a más de un millón de nosotros sin electricidad. Luego, llegó el huracán Beryl, que cobró la vida de más de 30 personas y dejó sin electricidad a más de 2 millones de personas en la área. Imagínate cuánto peor habría sido si Beryl hubiera sido una tormenta más fuerte, de Categoría 5.
Los políticos de extrema derecha en el Capitolio de Texas siguen fallándonos, preocupándose más por librar guerras culturales y ganar puntos políticos baratos contra los líderes de Houston que nos mantienen a salvo. Es hora de que los habitantes de Houston se unan para luchar por soluciones reales y progresistas. Necesitamos nuestra propia red eléctrica local, ¡y la necesitamos ahora!
Por eso, a través de la coalición Power Up Harris County, estamos pidiendo a nuestros funcionarios electos locales que creen un centro de energía en el condado de Harris para darnos la libertad de estar preparados, seguros y con energía para las tormentas futuras que sabemos que se avecinan.
FIRMA LA PETICIÓN si eres un residente del condado de Harris que está listo para el cambio que necesitamos. [https://actionnetwork.org/petitions/sign-the-petition-demand-local-leaders-build-a-local-energy-hub-in-harris-county/]
Uniéndose a la celebración de la vida de la Congresista Sheila Jackson Lee
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/SJL%20passing.jpg]
El personal y los miembros de TOP tuvieron el honor de asistir al servicio comunitario de despedida y reconocimiento [http://www.houstonchronicle.com/politics/houston/article/wheeler-baptist-sheila-jackson-lee-19610850.php] del Miércoles en memoria de la Congresista Sheila Jackson Lee.
Desde los pasillos del Congreso hasta las calles de Houston, Sheila Jackson Lee ejemplificó el servicio público y el liderazgo.
Conocida y tenaz, abordó su trabajo como legisladora con un compromiso inquebrantable con la justicia, la defensa de nuestras libertades y la mejora de las vidas de los residentes del condado de Harris. TOP se enorgullece de haber trabajado con la Congresista Sheila Jackson Lee durante años para abordar cuestiones que son importantes para los trabajadores de Houston, desde la vivienda hasta el acceso a la atención médica, los derechos al voto y más.
Nuestra organización está agradecida de haber tenido a la congresista como una aliada progresista en nuestra lucha por un #TXForAll, un estado donde todos se sientan valorados y puedan prosperar, sin importar nuestra edad, raza o género.
Extendemos nuestras más sinceras condolencias a los seres queridos de la congresista, así como a todos aquellos a quienes impactó positivamente durante sus más de 30 años como servidora pública.
Consejos de TOP: Prepare el horario de su familia antes de que comience el semestre escolar
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Family%20picnic.jpg]
Todavía queda una buena parte de las vacaciones de verano, pero si tiene hijos en edad escolar, sabe que hacer ajustes en los horarios diarios requiere tiempo y una preparación cuidadosa. Refrésquese sobre las formas de hacer que este proceso sea más fácil para usted y su familia antes de que la escuela comience nuevamente. [https://www.care.com/c/transitioning-from-summer-back-to-school/]

# When they stalk our children,
# the government has gone too far.
---
| | | | |
---|---
### Candidates spend thousands (and even millions) of dollars on a marketing "Focus Group" to come up with campaign phrases that will catch the attention of voters. Instead of spending big bucks on a marketing consultant, I sat around the table with 15 members of my large Mexican family celebrating my brother's birthday.
My family is the perfect focus group. We are a mixture of Republicans and Democrats and enjoy many spirited discussions. When it came to talk about our children, both factions reached the non-partisan conclusion that "the government has gone too far" when they come for our kids.
The government now makes it official that they want a separation between parents and their children! The government thinks they can raise your children better than you can!
I believe that, "When they stalk our children, the government has gone too far." is a unifying message that will put common sense Democrats and Republicans on the same page. Please help me get this message out so that I can carry your voice to Congress and join with a new Republican Administration to clean up the mess LEFT by the LEFT.

Cuando acosan a nuestro hijos,
el gobierno ha ido demasiado lejos.

body:
Americans consistently rate Congress as one of the most unpopular branches of our government.Americans consistently rate Congress as one of the most unpopular branches of our government.

This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zdrpa0luui0670egi80h8g1f1jkmb7j40c6ofvc8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cli60o36c9h2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, Americans consistently rate Congress as one of the most unpopular branches of our government. But do you know how the “sausage is made” in the halls of the U.S. Congress? Here’s a preview: It’s a far cry from the _Schoolhouse Rock!_ song many of us learned as kids. We have to go back to how our Founding Fathers designed the U.S. Congress if we’re going to understand this fully. Thankfully, Hillsdale College created our free online course, **“Congress: How It Worked and Why It Doesn’t,”** to do just that.****
---
| | And right now—for a limited time—this online course is available in a special DVD box set for viewing in your home or with a small group. **You can order your copy at this secure link:** **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/congress-thank-you](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zmdk8vd88h2cfr19q8v87c76asoe6svcv6vcolug_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cli60o36c9h2bs)** The 11-lecture course explores the Founders’ understanding of the legislative power and how Congress **should** work, the progressive rejection of that understanding, and how it has affected American politics. You can get your DVD box set of **“Congress: How It Worked and Why It Doesn’t”** right away with a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more.
---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zoledos6dug3ujrjei49t1jq5350gj2a97ibps3g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cli60o36c9h2bs)
---
| | And by doing so, your gift will also support our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts that **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans nationwide. As you may know, these online courses, including **“Congress: How It Worked and Why It Doesn’t”** and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty, are only possible because of the **generous support** from donors like you. ---
Nearly 100 years ago, the Ku Klux Klan stormed my great-grandfather’s home in Kentucky, dragged him out of his house, beat him, and carried him to a lynching tree. My grandmother, Lovie Kennedy, witnessed the assault. A small child, she screamed and wept uncontrollably. Her daddy was being executed right before her eyes. Sheryl Swoopes can’t forgive Caitlin Clark for being a white star in a league and sport dominated by black lesbians. Unbeknownst to her and the executioners, her father was a freemason. Standing at the tree, with a noose being prepared for his neck, my great-grandfather made some sort of hand or posture gesture that could only be understood by a fellow mason. Luckily for him, one of the Klansmen was a mason and objected to his killing.

subject: Our country is at risk

body:
Only the strong can preserve our freedom.

I'm proud to campaign with fellow veterans, and some of America's bravest warfighters, friend.

These tough conservatives are running for U.S. Senate, and I need them there with me to make America strong again after four years of failure from Joe Biden.

Here's more about each of them.

[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/RdK-WelAPMDO_JUPvsytSg~~/AARclAA~)

_Tim Sheehy is a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran who was awarded a Purple Heart and Silver Star for Valor. Tim is running for US Senate in Montana against 95% Biden voter Jon Tester. He needs our help to compete with Tester 's rich donors and liberals in the media._

[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/RdK-WelAPMDO_JUPvsytSg~~/AARclAA~)

_Dave McCormick is a West Point graduate, combat veteran, and Bronze Star recipient. He 's a devoted husband and proud father to six girls, and he wants to secure the American Dream for them. But Dave is being outraised 2-1 and needs our help to flip the script on career politician Bob Casey._

[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/RdK-WelAPMDO_JUPvsytSg~~/AARclAA~)

_Sam Brown is a West Point graduate, retired Army Captain, Purple Heart recipient, IED blast survivor, husband, and father. Sam spent three years recovering from his wounds in battle. He is a true American patriot and combat hero. Sam is down nearly 4-1 in the fundraising race against Jacky Rosen and needs our help to WIN this race._

[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/RdK-WelAPMDO_JUPvsytSg~~/AARclAA~)

_Jim Banks is an Afghanistan veteran who took time off from serving in the Indiana State Senate to deploy in both Operation Enduring Freedom and Freedom 's Sentinel. He's a tough conservative who won't bend a knee to the mob, and he's been a trusted partner in the U.S. House. Jim is running for Senate to ensure this open seat doesn't go to the Democrats -- and he needs our help to WIN._

******************************************************[SUPPORT THESE AMERICAN HEROES>>](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/RdK-WelAPMDO_JUPvsytSg~~/AARclAA~)******************************************************

These tough conservatives are stepping up to make America strong again.

They won't bend a knee to the mob. They will fight with me to stop the Left from sabotaging American power.

Our country will be stronger with more leadership from these conservative veterans -- and I'm proud to endorse ALL of them.

**[Will you make a split donation to support these American heroes?](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/RdK-WelAPMDO_JUPvsytSg~~/AARclAA~) **

In service,

[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/RdK-WelAPMDO_JUPvsytSg~~/AARclAA~)

Tom Cotton
U.S. Senator (R-AR)

# Support of Women
By Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District
---
Dear Peter,
There are 11 women and one man competing in the Paris Olympics who have connections to Nevada. We congratulate and support each of them. If Dina Titus had her way, many of these women might not be there. Here is a list of our wonderful athletes: * Faith Dillon - Women's Taekwondo * Katie Grimes - Women's Swimming * Claire Weinstein - Women's Swimming * Alexis Lagan \- Pistol Shooting * Beiwen Zhang - Women's Badminton * Luke Hobson - Men's Swimming * Perris Benegas - Women's Cycling * Stephanie Rovetti - Women's Rugby * A'ja Wilson - Women's Basketball * Chelsea Gray - Women's Basketball * Kelsey Plum - Women's Basketball * Jackie Young - Women's Basketball Each of these athletes worked hard for years to make it to the Olympics. However, some of the women might not have had this opportunity. Titus supports allowing biological males to compete in women's sports. This would result in men taking opportunities away from women. Even worse, she supports biological males showering with girls and women, and using the same bathroom facilities. This is not how to support women! Women's sports, showers, and restroom facilities should be for biological women. Period. Hard stop! The person I am today is a result of the men and women in my life. I love and respect the women who have influenced me. Here is a partial list: My wife, Lesly, chose to be a stay-at-home mom to raise our four children. She taught preschool in our home to hundreds of young children. From her, I've learned patience and charity. My mom, Patricia, served in the Navy and taught nursing at UNLV and CSN. From her, I learned the importance of serving others and our country. My female bosses in my military and civilian career taught me how to be an effective leader by showing respect for others. My daughter and daughters-in-law each have advanced college degrees and important careers in healthcare and education. They juggle competing demands while raising my grandchildren as equal partners with their husbands. From them, I've learned to respect the rising generation. As your representative in Congress, I will fight to protect the rights, opportunities, and safety of women and girls. This includes sports, healthcare, education, military service, and employment. Let's send a message to Titus that it is time for her to retire as she no longer represents the people of her district.
*******

However, some of the women might not have had this opportunity. Titus supports allowing biological males to compete in women's sports. This would result in men taking opportunities away from women. We have to go back to how our Founding Fathers designed the U.S. Congress if we're going to understand this fully. ## Hamas Leader Killed in Iran
The killing of [Hamas leader Ismail Haniyeh](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FugzAQQL8GNqK7s4PtwUOXbOnaEZ3xEa4yEIFF1L-v0rnj0xue3td9uLMWXR-fvEis0zbwWPWUwXfYkR1sm-MkQmJaieiIruiDw3aO7NPo0SUUL2lKGScymcX3CVIfwLQaCciCB0QARLpYtCkYEeOCETZTY0Gy1m2_fG-61lmm8rOdsl_GbWlLnGt9Ho35aOjW0I2fq7yOt3rDXnUs0tBNd167mRc-Oj12ltIZCL1nx2MyOGaf6BqyhP4KgDY5F9o95udLS9Gjd42Fx8Ja_pL13_8z0m8AAAD__wDpWzE) Wednesday in a predawn airstrike in Iran sparked fears of retaliation and wider regional conflict.The airstrike occurred shortly after Israel claimed to have killed a senior Hezbollah commander in Beirut, further escalating tensions in the region.While [Israel has not claimed responsibility](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO5CAQRL8GZ1jQMMYEBJc4m0svtDhohr7D9gjYsebvV95NN60qlZ7en_t691Rof_z2G7qejtWHTi9cZy456FUP0SVEQDWgkwbgJmdr5JBdMFNMSVo5JUg-KGFiUFrMk7UYw80O5ECAFrOQUggpYdRS_7UKURmr0KvEtMBI_ajjv4P2njGV9_HCOoZjG4rLvT8bU78YLAyW8zzHih8da7v6KzlqiQyWjWIsyNG3zmDJfvONh0yYOLXNU-HZ7_TGzP9TKRg5Vb_z71nz78Zb9x033Du_eLkwXEkGy1BdfJ5UCrXJMC0e19cXWv_R08vBZwAAAP__XaNrHA) for the airstrike against the Hamas leader in Tehran, it has drawn threats of revenge from Hamas and Iran.The events have also set back chances for [an imminent ceasefire in the Gaza](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7GSrCAQRb8GMy26QZGA4CVk89INLRzaoXdRppQad_5-y403vrfOqfNxm26BM2-P_2ElV5cyhXvlF01jCy3qSTfRLURIqiEHBrGH0RpoksPemrvpaZwjKgMwL72xc5T9MA5ysKZhhxK1HCWAlADYadCzVUTKWEVBLUJLilzL3n0W3mqiJb_Li_buXtYmu1Tr8xDqn0Av0J_n2YVvLse1CvQXW6CXRqBXINCnsIaj5WMNnNsUNn5Tar84Z4ot72FrdhefJ-fMx2CElo_r-Kuqf3a_HP4EAAD__-ccWAA) conflict, with Hamas vowing to take the battle to "new dimensions."
## Boar's Head Recall Hits 7 Million Pounds
Deli meat supplier, Boar's Head, expanded its recall to include 7 million additional pounds of deli and poultry products associated with a deadly multistate outbreak of listeria infections. [See a list of recalled items](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FuwyAQxvGngY3oOC6GDAxdvKVrR4uYs02Eg4WJq7x9lcwdP33DT_-f63ANKafH_B1W9m0qQxhbOnhwSiukgWT0EzOykey1RTxrd7FaLp6gi44sxKmLRnedc8Yy2WjoPDoGJ5NHQAIHWgNojSfSdLsYZmMvhoOZBAHH1Eo93Ut6tIWn_CoH19NYVpn90tq2C_MlsBfY30qo-8Ihvl-B_RZm3gX2b0OBVQbU_Zlf6rO3WuJzbKryGHKW1cftN-Wc9s4KgnkNKX-Q9m_x4fEvAAD__8-lVZE). The extended recall comes a week after Boar's Head initially recalled over 200,000 pounds of meat linked to two deaths and 33 hospitalizations [across 13 states](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFv8yAQgOFfg7ez4MCxPTB8GTx8Uip1qjpZxD4CLTYpXGP131ft3PldXj0vl_niYor77cltZNnn2S0cHzQPoADNbJrVeiIk3ZBVPWKnhrFXTbBkVtVJqYzpsCPslPaL7hc_-OG6nPpTEy1KNHKQSkmpFLZGmeuoiXQ_anLaCyNpjZxL-5bjzoF8-soPKu2StybZwHyvQv8TOAmcjuNot7r_NIET7fBZBU6BXOIgcMocqAicNneHGvJRQWmo7JgqHJEDpFiZSnSwuEoVUtzfaQXOcM2uVAjkVii0uJQETq7A-aw-Xsf_z02x6_2IKcV66oWRt83F9HvIf3I9LH4HAAD__2RybQU). The [new recall includes](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFugzAQgOGnMZsRdzYYBg9dUJd06dARHfYRXBmMjJM0b1-lc-dv-fV_XaYLhRj26wdtbMuSJnIl3HnqJUjUk668XZiRVcUWDGIL_WCgWq0B3RN2ZgGvF2p1O6uZ-s64wdHQdqoKFhvUTd8ANA0A1hr0PChmZQbFpBahG_ahpFx_p7CXlZf4THfOtUtbFe1aynEK9SZwFDjS7HZ-nPU1vVjg-M4UyypwfITMnyXlp8BxTpRPuTJ5yT8H7f6UmR3FKMPu4s2zNHILMYa0yyPdXg6AGnWLfZWtPx4vPDsjdHPdKMS_lvLvmLvF3wAAAP__h0hlWw) 71 products made between May 10 and July 29 at the Jarratt, Virginia, processing plant under the Boar's Head and Old Country brand names. People [who bought the recalled products](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvhSAURn-Nbhi48EQHhi5ur2tHc4XrkwbBAO_Z_vvGpmO3k5x8yZfzcZ_v6IOPj3fcydQ1zWirf9E8MMFAzap1ZiUCki0ZoQFuYhi1aDfjlFjVOq6S0IEdl0Wjvtle83GAXkrZegMcFB-4EJwLAZ0SahklkdSjJJRrozg5X1PuPpOPdaM1fKcX5c6mvQ1mq_UojXxrYGpgOs-zi4uNdJbLNzBd2MD0LOyPloS5sI3QsUwWQ2D0dWB0hflow9MR02z3IfgU2ZGel3AUPNsJKwu-VMoeWbYRRa-U6tts3HFeg9LrRvHHjj78nqv_lnoZ-AkAAP__PiNswg) are advised to throw the items away or return them to the store. Customers should also clean out their refrigerators as the bacteria can grow in cold temperatures and spread to other foods.
## List: Biggest Homes in Each State
A list of the [biggest homes in each state](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2OszAQAJ_GdEb22vwVLr6GLl97JdrgBe_J4Chsgnj7U66-djTSSPN1m27Imff1P24UZCkTzsJvmnptNfjJVzEsRECuomA7gMb2Q2erFO7zYgEb089d75rBN9ZG37aubZzFIcaKAxjwpjfWGmMt1N76--CIXDc4QrcobyiylGf9XXiXREu-ypue9Vy2Kock8jiU-6dgVDCe51kvuHG-Eu7x2nD_aArGzIcoGCWRvvO60iE6lY0075pwTvoQFNKSUPTJOetDXru-ykvBWD1DfHwgH22nvFk35Pxblz9XvAP8BAAA__8h3WGO) showcases magnificent manors, chateaus, ranches, and a 33,000 square foot basement with a 103-seat movie theater. The largest home in the U.S. is the Biltmore Estate in Asheville, North Carolina. It boasts 175,000 square feet, 35 bedrooms, 43 bathrooms, and 65 fireplaces.Many of the homes on the list are connected to American history. The 130-room Shadow Lawn served as a summer home for President Woodrow Wilson, and New York's Oheka Castle appeared in the classic film "Citizen Kane." Perhaps the most fun house is the Chase Mansion in Connecticut. Not only does it have that vast basement theater, but it also includes a game room, music room, and concession stand. [You can see the full list of homes here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2OszAQAJ_GdEb22vwVLr6GLl97JdrgBe_J4Chsgnj7U66-djTSSPN1m27Imff1P24UZCkTzsJvmnptNfjJVzEsRECuomA7gMb2Q2erFO7zYgEb089d75rBN9ZG37aubZzFIcaKAxjwpjfWGmMt1N76--CIXDc4QrcobyiylGf9XXiXREu-ypue9Vy2Kock8jiU-6dgVDCe51kvuHG-Eu7x2nD_aArGzIcoGCWRvvO60iE6lY0075pwTvoQFNKSUPTJOetDXru-ykvBWD1DfHwgH22nvFk35Pxblz9XvAP8BAAA__8h3WGO).

body:
Don’t wait until it’s too late. | | |
# Protect Your Money Before It's Too Late
---
|
---
Chuck Norris here... I've spent my entire life as a proud American. America has been a great place to live, work, and raise a family. But right now, I'm deeply troubled at what I see happening to our nation--and what the future may hold for our children and grandchildren.
---
| | **Just take a look around.**
---
* We're **$34 Trillion** in debt
* Inflation is running **over 3%**
* A recession is on our doorstep
* And the people in charge keep spending our money.

---

I won't lie to you, Peter: Rick Scott’s speech and aggressive ad spending could spell disaster for our odds of winning Florida and keeping the Senate blue. Here's why: This is one of the most competitive Senate races in the entire country — and it could determine control of the Senate AND our next Senate majority leader. That's why Rick Scott spent SIX FIGURES of his own fortune to run Spanish-language ads during the Copa America broadcast to lie about me. With new polling showing me and Rick Scott locked in a STATISTICAL TIE, the GOP will stop at nothing to make sure they defeat me. That's why I NEED to make sure we have strong grassroots support to keep extremists like Rick Scott out of power in the Senate. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. **And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect:_ after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t._** **__When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.__** **Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. The Federal Aviation Administration has approved commercial drone flights [without visual observers](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O8yAQAJ8Gd1iw_BgXFF_jLl97pbU2S4yEQ4Q5O3n706W-ejTSaL5u8w1TTo_7f9zJt1csM64tnTQ7LjnoWXfBLyKMsiMvBwAjtRtlt3lHwpFCY1SMKLVYlQZlNcpFWjVE1SUPArRwQkphLIy9EVY7GRerwmKEkkwLCqmV2reNGr3wiPldTqr9WvYu-62158HUPwYTg-m6rv6KiL-QwYS1pTUTg-lB18FgymXFzGAKtTyIB8rppPrmAXPGg1fay4mZR0S-fdfwMcENHMbROkLFDYHlWojIndQjD2jWICAYNcqu-vC8Us7psAPT4r5jyp_I9vey08NPAAAA__8rU2q-) for two delivery companies in the Dallas area. ## Radio Host's Mistress Gets Life for Senior Scam
Debra Mae Carter, the alleged mistress of Christian radio host William "Doc" Gallagher, [was sentenced to life in prison](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxs0L2u3CAQxfGnwd2sYIxtXFCkobtpU1oYxtdINlgw2Y88fbRb3_pIPx39_3wtXz4dKX__9idZfm5l8YHTnRYDClAvuot2lXFWHVk1IQ5Km1l1u42bDN6gmYMedaAJvafNRJxI4TybrUsWJWpppFJyGHG-DXLURm3r2Md1kL0SWlJMXOqNd2J6-rYdr3Knegvl7A67M19N9L8EOoEuv67S-D0JdG9ZoJOTQNcrge5vg0yPJtB9IAh7TY2Tz1B9TAX20hh4JzhLphfEErhUOFPjSq1BpLV6CL4yVWiUmXKgCFzgSBtBynCV_C9BCzudJNB11cbrkY4jtXESWn6fPh2f3_xzxbvF_wEAAP__PfR2Rw) Tuesday for her role in a $31 million Ponzi scheme targeting senior citizens. ## Dog Stolen by Amazon Driver Recovered
An Austin woman, Melissa Turrentine, took matters into her own hands [after her Yorkshire Terrier](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyrCAUgOGnwQ4HjkeEguI2dnvbWzpHOO5yg7KjRDd5-kxSp_6bf75_t-lGKaft_pdW9vW1lIlCTSdPVmoJOGET_ayi0w17PQD0Gq3TzcMjD6AGDIMLgaIDZKutgQUH07nZ2iZ5UIDKKq1Vb8C1vTJo9TKbLs696rRAxTHVsrf1wZVfdCz5o5y8t6GsTfaPWp-H6P4IGAWM13W1b-c7f0cBI-01hcwCxo2vQ8CYS6AsYPxfMm8sY7lLWumzbHLJ_JJxTyfvAkYwToKyKlK0EhBBYmeinIe-l0SdIQpKa-ua3cfnlXJOhxkEqvtKKf-c1d-dTg9fAQAA__9P8Gan), Jolene, was allegedly stolen by an Amazon Flex driver last week. Using [creative detective work](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskD1vgzAUAH-N2Yyen42BwUMXtnTtiPzxnFgxOAIH0v76Kp07nm453ddlvtiU03r9tAuZ-opltr6mg-aBC45qVk0wDsIoGjKiR-yEGkbR3IyWPtLgvHMBYtcR6R50GKyVowjShiYZBFQwgBDQaRzbDrQaRHRaBteBFEwBhVTL1tYbVXrZPebvctDW-rI02dxqfexMfjCcGE7nebb340lvyXCyW00-E8NppXNnOPktLW-0z72mle-1ZFp5KFduF_tTVl436-88lHNlOKEeuRaaaIyRQy8DV4GIO9SaI_joh945OUKzmfA4U85p1z1TcF1syn999f9bh8HfAAAA__-5iGtV), including spotting the driver's house number in a TikTok video, Turrentine and a group of friends and engaged strangers tracked him down. Her son-in-law confronted the driver, who [admitted to taking Jolene](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxsjz1rhEAQQH_NbncyM666FlsEglVMcQRCKtkvz4U1Hjqnd_n14VKnfQ8evM9-6G3K6fvybudo-D4ug_Wc9jjoE55IDUoG4yC0KKPBhqhCpVuUk3E0YnC6aj026Mkr65sIDTjdBu9AyWQISIEGRKhqaosKaqVxdHUZXAUlCgUxJF7WgqfI8W63MT-WPa6FX2aZzcR83UT5IqgT1B3HUTyWG99cfPonsewnUXa7KF-xP3-8pSOdf77kasL1SDmnrW6EgstsU_5L8v-Du6HfAAAA__-DrFJL) after initially denying it, returning the dog without her collar. Amazon and local police are now investigating the incident.

Michigan: Previously Deported Illegal Alien Accused of Sexually Assaulting Young Girl

---
My heart is broken for the 13 year old girl who was brutally assaulted by this illegal immigrant who had been deported. Our borders are broken, and the children of our nation are paying the price.

# Melton for Iowa 2024
---
---
| Hello Peter,

This is Ryan Melton, Democrat running for the U.S. House in Iowa's 4th Congressional District. During my 2024 campaign, I'll send you a weekly email to keep you in the loop while not overwhelming your inbox. Typically, the newsletter will be a review from the week prior: Where we went, what issues of note were on the minds of those I met with, where we'll be in the next week, etc.
Where I went on the campaign trail last week: *Sorry I'm late in getting the newsletter out this week. My wife's in the hospital so things have been hectic.* Last week, I hit the county fair circuit yet again, speaking with folks at Democratic Party fair booths in Hamilton, Humboldt, Harrison, and Plymouth Counties. I also walked with the Kossuth Co Dems in the Sweet Corn Days Parade in Fenton, and spoke at the Iowa Democratic Party's Liberty and Justice event in Des Moines. I'll link my speech there in the media section down below.
The pressing issue on the campaign trail last week: Without a doubt, the issue of the week last week was reproductive rights. It came up at just about every stop, and it's fitting considering Iowa's 6 week abortion ban went into effect this week. Some thoughts:

1. I am pro-choice. I don't believe that the moment someone becomes pregnant should be the moment they lose control over their body and choices. Instead, I believe the opposite: That considering the moral and ethical complexity of the issue, we should be empowering people to make their own decisions in that regard, not some disconnected government bureaucrat that doesn't know of the context and nuance of that person's life and circumstances.
2. I have spoken to plenty of folks who identify as "pro-life" who are well-intended and really think they are doing the right thing when taking that stance. While I disagree with the practical implications of their stance, I understand it and respect it when held with honest intentions. We adopted our five year old. We were there with him at birth. HIs birth mom was in a desperate spot when she found out she was pregnant. She went to a Planned Parenthood to have an abortion but couldn't go through with it. I have so much empathy for her and the desperation she was feeling, and am so grateful I have my boy. I can understand the "pro-life" perspective from that, for example.
3. However, abortion bans don't end abortion or even notably reduce them, they just create more dangerous ones, and they also have other downstream terrifying consequences, such as putting medical professionals and their patients with pregnancy complications in almost impossible situations. These complex situations are almost impossible to legislate clearly enough, and have contributed to a lack of interest of med students and OB-GYNS in coming to practice in red states due to fears of legal repercussions due to legislative vagueness. This is not a pro-life outcome, as infant and maternal mortality rise as OB-GYN availabilty rates fall. Iowa is last in the country in OB-GYN availability rate.
4. Also, per the CDC, 2 million Americans will have a rape-related pregnancy in their lifetimes, and I absolutely think it's indefensible to take someone's choice away in that circumstance. Plus, per the Iowa abortion ban, it forces the outing by rape and incest victims of their assaulters before they can get an exception, which means a lot of incredibly vulnerable people who traditionally underreport these incidents because of fear of retribution are now going to be put in that awful predicament.
5. We have plenty of international case studies where abortion was legislatively banned, and the consequences for freedom and public health have been jarring. We're now seeing this play out in abortion ban states as well, and will soon unfortunately be seeing this in our state as well.
6. I instead would advocate for other ways to naturally reduce the number of abortions that occur without taking reproductive rights away from people. I would advocate for free and easily accessible birth control, affordable and accessible child care, health care, mental health care, and housing, good paying jobs, sex ed programs, and making adoption much more affordable and accessible. In my opinion, that is actually the true "pro-life" platform.
7. Finally, while I have spoken to many folks who identify as "pro-life" (and yes, we could debate over what that term actually means) who really mean it, who really believe they are doing the right thing, there are a lot of politicians that use that same moniker that are not doing it for honest reasons, but instead are using it as a wedge issue to divide people. The Kate Cox story in Texas for example, where her fetus was no longer viable and yet the state still did everything in its power to intimidate her and health care professionals from giving her a medically necessary abortion, as her health care professionals told her she was facing death the longer she carried the fetus. She had to flee the state to find care. Some don't have the resources to do that. Politicians are also claiming Democrats want to allow abortion even after birth and people are believing it, which is ridiculously not true. Over 99% of abortions happen well before viability, and abortions that happen after 24 weeks happen rarely and because of emergency. Abortion is health care, it's not being used recklessly.

Our schedule for this week: Unfortunately with my wife in the hospital, my plans this week have been scuttled, and at this point I don't think I can commit to anything this weekend, so I don't want to make any promises I can't keep. If I am able to hit the trail, I'll update you all on my campaign socials.
Recent press/social media posts of note: https://www.bleedingheartland.com/2024/07/28/six-reasons-im-motivated-to-keep-going-in-a-red-district/
We again are rejecting all Corporate PAC money, so we really rely on, and are extremely grateful for your support. We'll spend your donations on ways to expand our reach to as many voters as possible, including: -Post cards and other mailers and postage -Hand out cards for events -Text messaging campaigns -Transportation costs for events and door knocking -Campaign website costs -Radio ads, Social Media Ads, and (hopefully) TV ads -Our campaign staffers
Finally, if you have anyone else in mind that would like to be added to our email list or who would be interested in volunteering, let us know at melton4iowa@gmail.com!
Let's keep fighting the good fight together! Ryan Melton

We have plenty of international case studies where abortion was legislatively banned, and the consequences for freedom and public health have been jarring. We're now seeing this play out in abortion ban states as well, and will soon unfortunately be seeing this in our state as well. 6. I instead would advocate for other ways to naturally reduce the number of abortions that occur without taking reproductive rights away from people. I would advocate for free and easily accessible birth control, affordable and accessible child care, health care, mental health care, and housing, good paying jobs, sex ed programs, and making adoption much more affordable and accessible. In my opinion, that is actually the true "pro-life" platform. 7. Finally, while I have spoken to many folks who identify as "pro-life" (and yes, we could debate over what that term actually means) who really mean it, who really believe they are doing the right thing, there are a lot of politicians that use that same moniker that are not doing it for honest reasons, but instead are using it as a wedge issue to divide people. The Kate Cox story in Texas for example, where her fetus was no longer viable and yet the state still did everything in its power to intimidate her and health care professionals from giving her a medically necessary abortion, as her health care professionals told her she was facing death the longer she carried the fetus. She had to flee the state to find care. Some don't have the resources to do that. Politicians are also claiming Democrats want to allow abortion even after birth and people are believing it, which is ridiculously not true. Over 99% of abortions happen well before viability, and abortions that happen after 24 weeks happen rarely and because of emergency. Abortion is health care, it's not being used recklessly. Our schedule for this week: Unfortunately with my wife in the hospital, my plans this week have been scuttled, and at this point I don't think I can commit to anything this weekend, so I don't want to make any promises I can't keep. If I am able to hit the trail, I'll update you all on my campaign socials. Recent press/social media posts of note: We again are rejecting all Corporate PAC money, so we really rely on, and are extremely grateful for your support. We'll spend your donations on ways to expand our reach to as many voters as possible, including: -Post cards and other mailers and postage -Hand out cards for events -Text messaging campaigns -Transportation costs for events and door knocking -Campaign website costs -Radio ads, Social Media Ads, and (hopefully) TV ads -Our campaign staffers Finally, if you have anyone else in mind that would like to be added to our email list or who would be interested in volunteering, let us know at melton4iowa@gmail.com! Let's keep fighting the good fight together! Ryan Melton == | | | | | | | | == | == == == | == | P.O. body:
Each generation has been asked to defend our democracy before.

Peter, We, the American people, as always, have to stand up for our democracy by voting in defense of democracy this fall. The responsibility is ours, and so is the power. We as regular American citizens have immense amounts of power. I trust that with all of us standing together, and putting every ounce of energy we have into this cause for the next few months, decency and grace will prevail over extremism and fury. **There’s no doubt that we are in what feels like an unprecedented moment — but each generation has been asked to defend our democracy before. This is now our time.** **The thing that keeps me hopeful and optimistic is understanding our nation's history. There have always been trying times, but when the people unite and work we always win, and democracy is always protected and enhanced.** From Valley Forge, to Gettysburg, to Seneca Falls, to Normandy, to Selma, to Stonewall, every generation of Americans is called upon to defend our democracy, and every generation of Americans has done so. Ours cannot be the first generation that fails to defend and enhance our democracy. So I’m asking you to work with us at the NDRC. If we stand together, if we work together, if we sacrifice together, if we commit ourselves to this cause, I know that we can be that next generation to make our democracy better, and make our nation more fair. The NDRC has a winning plan in place to help build a truly representative democracy — supporting outstanding candidates in key states, advocating for pro-democracy ballot measures, enhancing our partnerships, playing the long game with our 10 Year Plan, and more. So let’s work together and let’s continue the project of building a better nation. **It takes all of us. **[**The investment you make today will have an immediate impact in November and a lasting one for many years to come. clean_body: Each generation has been asked to defend our democracy before. | Peter, We, the American people, as always, have to stand up for our democracy by voting in defense of democracy this fall. The responsibility is ours, and so is the power. We as regular American citizens have immense amounts of power. I trust that with all of us standing together, and putting every ounce of energy we have into this cause for the next few months, decency and grace will prevail over extremism and fury. There’s no doubt that we are in what feels like an unprecedented moment — but each generation has been asked to defend our democracy before. This is now our time. The thing that keeps me hopeful and optimistic is understanding our nation's history. There have always been trying times, but when the people unite and work we always win, and democracy is always protected and enhanced. From Valley Forge, to Gettysburg, to Seneca Falls, to Normandy, to Selma, to Stonewall, every generation of Americans is called upon to defend our democracy, and every generation of Americans has done so. Ours cannot be the first generation that fails to defend and enhance our democracy. So I’m asking you to work with us at the NDRC. If we stand together, if we work together, if we sacrifice together, if we commit ourselves to this cause, I know that we can be that next generation to make our democracy better, and make our nation more fair. The NDRC has a winning plan in place to help build a truly representative democracy — supporting outstanding candidates in key states, advocating for pro-democracy ballot measures, enhancing our partnerships, playing the long game with our 10 Year Plan, and more. So let’s work together and let’s continue the project of building a better nation. Fellow Patriot,

_I have major election integrity news to share with you from Arizona. _

My team at America First Legal just sent legal demand letters to all 15 Arizona County Recorders demanding they take action to remove foreign citizens from their voter rolls.

_Some background on this situation... _

\*\*As of April, there were 35,273 registered voters in Arizona who had failed to provide proof of their citizenship, but had not yet been removed from the voter rolls. This is unacceptable and a serious threat to the integrity of the upcoming federal elections. \*\*

_For comparison, the 2020 presidential election in Arizona was decided by only 10,457 votes... _

Meanwhile, Arizona law requires county recorders to perform monthly list maintenance to confirm the citizenship of federal-only registered voters. The list maintenance law requires county recorders to consult three specific databases to check the citizenship of registrants.

However, Arizona Secretary of State Adrian Fontes has never negotiated with the relevant agencies to get access to those databases for list maintenance. \*\*Because of this, county recorders are not performing the necessary list maintenance to verify the citizenship of federal-only voters.\*\*

\*\*This is unacceptable. This is criminal, and clearly designed to allow voter fraud. \*\*

That’s why our letters demand that Arizona election officials fulfill their legal obligations to prevent illegal aliens and other non-citizens from voting. And it warns them of the severe legal consequences they will face from America First Legal if they fail to do their job.

\*\*_SUPPORT OUR EFFORTS HERE >> ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=19233600.7709.1.e6275bbdd1eb6efac588ccdb5541bd35 )_\*\*

We will not allow officials in the State of Arizona to avoid their legal obligations to remove illegal aliens from their voter rolls- and that’s why we’re ramping up our aggressive legal action.

Please support us in our fight against the lawless left right now. Thank you.

Stephen Miller

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1718%2E135344%2Ebj6hlt)

We’re writing to express our gratitude for your support throughout our fundraising push this week – and for bearing with the onslaught of outreach from our team.
These messages can be a lot to wade through, but hopefully you believe these messages are a small price to pay for a Democratic Senate and White House to make progress on the issues you care about.
As you know, the Michigan's Senate primary is in a few days. That's when we'll find out who our Republican opponent will be in the general election. And over the past several months, GOP candidates up and down the ballot have been working through the state to capture something called "voter IDs."
A "voter ID" is just a simple declaration of support from potential voters.
It is a campaign contacting a voter, and a voter saying "Yes, I support you," or "No, I am supporting someone else."
These replies are the foundation of any campaign, because it’s how we know where our supporter base exists and who we need to turn out in November.
Before the election, campaigns try to make sure their stated supporters vote. And at other times -- especially when a candidate needs it most -- they will turn to those supporters for help.
So today, we are doing the same. We are asking you to add your name as a "Personal Endorser" of Elissa Slotkin's campaign for Senate. It's a small and simple act, but it will speak volumes about the grassroots support for our campaign as we head into the general election:
**[Can Elissa count on you to add your name as a Personal Endorser of her campaign for United States Senate in Michigan? If we're in this together, we'll keep this seat blue in November.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/signup/endorse-elissa-mar24?source=em240301-1-15&refcode2=1718.135344.bj6hlt&akid=1718%2E135344%2Ebj6hlt)**

Unfortunately, we fell 7% short of our end-of-month goal. **[_Will you donate $5 to help get us back on track so we can defeat Rick Scott?_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90003425/489118644/849749119?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk1633-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiY2VlYzgwZjItMGM1MC1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=5kxVjcPngdpSney87YIQc_sow3NAxklwrthdhYxVAEs=)**

Dear Friend,

Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America.

**The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.**

Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents...

...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties.

At the same time, with the help of the media it...

Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption.

Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=f6f09a7a309b4ec3bab019e5b49e0401&_e=tgWfbOSGxppFhRdGfdYtHMCb-sjyTdAtWyRm6CuPtG31eN3zKQNHy8Lmxkii4kaTcU4aEDGTDiMSbHcp5kz9jLo11CM4_2JznFhcE0YRdEUJgwXF2KG8vDzk5fQZPFhRZpbk2iS9eDr_YdokfK3xKuykAl2g5XY83EiqMNbwwtD_dCdln8geP--g_M5vs7Rlp49ws3Bvl1rZ0MbeOQF5u0OkIO3hEifTyjap5mwJGXOe12_9TjHxublFUaIIqGDsAVZIYdXOV5nyCkRctW2sj1RLL_j3eVP5JH2jHW2SGOFBYG5f0qVQdRvOPuGonVq8J-Snw1gEzdy2QFoQkdnDyZuP8-agKCMzhelz-2XXfZeBxblfxQSpvS1ZwdbCwCF6n8-xQS2VWqnK_KL880-vjaKiQi_mwZzbl01uwd8qf8s%3D)**

Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

I wanted to send a quick email just to say: **Thank you!**
Last night, we were facing our first end-of-month fundraising deadline since I became the official Democratic nominee against Lauren Boebert. **With help from over 24,000 grassroots donors like you, I’m happy to report that we didn’t just hit our fundraising goal – _we crushed it!_**
In 95 days, we are going to defeat Lauren Boebert and make her nothing more than an embarrassing footnote in the history books.
In 2022, Adam Frisch almost sent Boebert packing. He lost by just 546 votes. Now, Lauren Boebert is running in my district. She thought that if she moved across the entire state and carpetbagged in a new congressional district, that maybe she wouldn’t face a strong challenge from another Democrat...
_She was wrong._**The polls show that we are hot on Boebert’s trail and that we can finish the job in 2024 and defeat Lauren Boebert.**
There’s going to be a lot of fundraising deadlines between now and Election Day. We are going to need volunteers to sign up for shifts. I am going to be asking a lot – and please know that I am so incredibly grateful for everything you do.
This campaign isn’t about me. It isn’t about Boebert. It’s about protecting our democracy, protecting our rights and freedoms, and electing someone who cares about the people of this district.
Together, we are going to win this race and defeat Lauren Boebert.
I am so grateful to you for your support,
Trisha

name: Charity Barry
subject: ENDORSED by Fourteen Elected Officials Across the District and State!
body:
Plus - Coming Events You Don't Want to Miss!
| | | |
---
| Endorsed By Fourteen Elected Officials!
---
| I am pleased to announce that I have received the endorsement of fourteen elected officials from each county of the district and across and state!
Through their time earning the trust of the voters and serving their constituents, they understand what it takes to represent the good people of Wisconsin.
They believe that I am the best choice for our district, and I am truly honored by their support!
Please join them and cast your vote for Charity Barry on August 13th!
---
|
---
| | |
---
|
### In my thirty years of involvement with local government, I have met many people. Of those, one that really stands out is Charity Barry.

### Her energy and enthusiasm for whatever she's doing makes her a natural leader. Her involvement in the family business provides her with a good background to be a US Representative. I'm happy to endorse Charity for US Congress.

~Harvey Kubly
---
---
|
---
|
Gary Benson, Lafayette County Supervisor, District 10
Janel Brandtjen, Wisconsin Assemblywoman, District 22
Don Gander, Iowa County Supervisor, District 17
Pam Johnson-Loy, Town of Dodgeville Supervisor, Iowa County
Rebecca Klitzke, Sauk County Supervisor, District 6
Dan Knodl, Wisconsin Senator, District 8
Harvey Kubly, Green County Supervisor, District 22
Andrea Lombard, Sauk County Supervisor, District 14 and Baraboo City Councilmember, District 5
Dave Murphy, Wisconsin Assemblyman, District 56
Emmett Reilly, Lafayette County Supervisor, District 14
Kurt Shafer, Former Green County Supervisor, District 24
Derek Statz, Town of Berry Supervisor, Dane County
Doug Sutter, Rock County Supervisor, District 2
Chuck Wichgers, Wisconsin Assemblyman, District 82
---
| | |
### Charity Barry is intelligent, has great new ideas and common sense, and is passionate about a positive future for the residents of Wisconsin. I am happy to endorse Charity Barry for the 2nd District of Wisconsin.

~Pam Johnson-Loy
---
|
---
| |
---
| Event With Senator Ron Johnson!
---
|
---
---
| | |
---|---
I am honored to welcome Senator Johnson to our event at the Madison Club on August 9th!

Working as his District Grassroots Director in the 2022 cycle was a privilege. It gave me a great opportunity to increase my experience in grassroots work across the district!
---
| |
---|---
As we did our part, working tirelessly to ensure the Senator was re-elected, I was reminded of his personal encouragement to me to stay involved, keep fighting, and never back down!

With that advice, I led our team to make sure we knocked every door and made every call we could!

| |
---|---
We had teams of volunteers in every county of the district who were proud to stand up and fight for
Truth and Freedom!

And because we never stopped working towards victory, Senator Johnson received nearly 5,000 more votes than the Republican Congressional Candidate in our district!

And... I got to sign the bus!
| |
---|---
Now, I need your support to ensure that I can work side by side with Senator Johnson to represent each and every one of you and our American values in both the House and Senate!

Senator Johnson has proven himself as one who will not bend under pressure, regardless of the source or veracity of the attack, and I look forward to joining him in DC to fight for you
no matter what!

I look forward to seeing you on August 9th!
|

I'm in first place in the primary and gaining momentum headed towards the November election. Look, I'm not saying this will be easy. Quite the opposite. It's going to be a nonstop, 58-county fight between now and November 5th. This is going to be an expensive fight. Hiring staff, recruiting and training volunteers, equipping them with the very best technology to identify our voter and secure their vote by November 5th. There's no time to lose. In closing, I can't help but think how Adam Schiff and his team of high-priced DC consultants thought they were being savvy in trying to make sure I became their opponent in General Election. Reports are they even spent money running ads promoting me. But what they've really done is awaken a sleeping giant here. Remember, before it became a wasteland of crime, homelessness, and sky-high taxes, California was a land of dreamers, a land of opportunity. It was a place where a scrawny little kid could start as a bat boy for his heroes, work hard, win a World Series, and land on a Topps baseball card. California can be that place again. America can be that place again. And it starts with throwing out political liars and connivers like Adam Schiff and reclaiming our freedom roots. Time is the most important factor. Thank you! | | | | Steve Garvey #6 | | | P.S. Adam Schiff had $35 million in the bank. Well, reports are now coming out that he spent upwards of $25 million in the primary and is down to $10 million in the bank. Make no mistake, while his cash advantage is greatly diminished, as I write these words, Adam Schiff, Nancy Pelosi, and Chuck Schumer are quickly reloading. The ActBlue political machine has the capacity to pump millions into his race in the blink of an eye. You and I cannot give them any daylight. Please don't delay. | | PAID FOR BY STEVE GARVEY FOR U.S. SENATE PO Box 532389 Los Angeles, CA 90053-2389 |

name: Tom Fitton
subject: Warning!
body:
A warning (technically, a "notice letter") is what Judicial Watch sent to the Oregon Secretary of State last week, warning the State of Oregon of their evident violations of the National Voter Registration Act (NVRA) requiring the removal of inactive voters from their voter rolls.

| | |
---
|
---
|
---
| Dear Fellow American,

A warning (technically, a "notice letter") is what Judicial Watch sent to the Oregon Secretary of State last week, warning the State of Oregon of their evident violations of the National Voter Registration Act (NVRA) requiring the removal of inactive voters from their voter rolls.
If Oregon fails to begin cleaning its voter rolls in a timely fashion, we will go to federal court and sue them!
Our warning to Oregon is based on our election law team's thorough review of federal and state election data. This is a detailed, demanding, "roll up your sleeves" process...a _process that no other group in the country undertakes_.
It is also expensive!
**[That's why I hope you will make a special contribution to Judicial Watch today!](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69369&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)**
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69369&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

Dirty election rolls can mean dirty elections

...and with a presidential election less than four months away, it is vital that Oregon gets to work cleaning its voter registration rolls of ineligible voters to remove any cloud of doubt over the legitimacy of its balloting.

The corrupt Biden Justice Department should be pursuing this action in court, not Judicial Watch...but for years the Justice Department has failed to do its duty.

And that's why...[with the support you have given us in the past](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69369&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)...Judicial Watch has stepped into the breach, and already forced the removal of over 4.5 million ineligible voters from voter lists across the country...and that number is about to go up!

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69369&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

When states won't clean their voter lists as the law requires and the Justice Department fails to take action, Judicial Watch goes into action.

We don't just _talk_ about honest elections...we _deliver_ real, tangible results.

And I don't believe there is anything more important in the fight to preserve our Republic than to preserve honest elections.

Thank you for your past support of Judicial Watch, and for our mission of upholding the rule of law.

[I hope you will help us again today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69369&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2). I promise you that every day, your Judicial Watch is fighting for you and honest government!

Sincerely,

Thomas Fitton
President

| | |

| _**_The end of safe spaces_**_
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=0bacf6c947&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
|
* * *
---
|
#### A drag queen “Last Supper.” And at the Olympics’ opening ceremonies, no less.
---
|
#### By Guy Ciarrocchi
---
| "In real time from Tokyo to Nairobi and Buenos Aires to St. Petersburg, the world got to see what 'woke' is. The world got to learn that self-declared elites find it necessary to attack and mock whatever they disagree with. It’s not enough to privately disagree with — or not support — what others believe. It’s important to them to mock it. To tear it down.
...
The mockery and attacks are not limited to the editorial pages of the New York Times or woke-focused late night talk shows. Signs, impromptu remarks, protests, and staged events now are displayed or take place unexpectedly, anywhere, anytime.

At coffee shops, at NFL football games, at a Broadway play, during awards ceremonies, during graduations, on highways near airports. And now the Olympics."

---
