Fellow American,

**"While I am in Congress, no one will take Somalia's sea." - United States Congresswoman Ilhan Omar (MN-05)**
Yes, this is an actual quote from a Representative in the United States Congress. More importantly, this is an actual quote from my opponent, who I plan on sending back to Somalia on November 5th. She does not deserve to represent me or you any longer.

[**Help me buy her plane ticket with a donation to my campaign of any amount.**](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=96119dd4d3af455383f34fef3f380d88&_e=58RQW9xuxOMsjPnZ_d0HNYRFZeZG4Ufqk6Jcug-dVBtckPyqEbw5XhYigasOkAzdaFNzACM_-ySSpKRtkLR678m5BnH2QiuKI-6Dy5vGQYWI88kipXa9GLxqWLXp7PlZWnkHGQhgWThJBzHbCGMAqmBcILe8X0h-6_y6lX08MXyYxTnbWQgD2umMzjHV1vvG8PtsqKUynORg2Z71A9U_3K6NY9hE4Vgg6EcqX8C_9yTTXAu_MOH0dlWgov9muO-k4dTiOYH2t3VfDuwlcaBdL-TUaQnMObiv3xLGRCDFu4klIckeOYiNfwjQx7b-Xbaal083Fs1ln09BOvsYPp2oFYZhv1lwGnC0n2oVyyTMNKuhE2NsGNwLIpvqD5gZ1Hy8gr9jJQC2go4shNW-uWeygzqr8wx4SnKt7ckS96chNC84JMRJRAVCtRWGk_ETH9lH)

Ilhan Omar has made it clear time and time again that her allegiance lies with Somalia, Hamas, and other American-hating groups. Meanwhile, she disgraces the halls of Congress in Washington, D.C., every day by aligning herself with the Squad and the most Radical factions of the Radical Left.

**I've had enough, and so have the people of Minnesota-05. It's time to expel her from Congress, and that starts with winning this election on November 5.**

But Ilhan Omar has the backing of the Squad and the Deep State Democrats' millions of dollars. The only way we can win is with a strong, nationwide grassroots Conservative effort.

**That's why I'm setting a goal to collect just 50 donations by midnight tonight. No donation is too small (or large) to make a difference in this race.**
[**I'm humbly asking you to send my campaign a donation to help me hit my midnight donor goal.**](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=96119dd4d3af455383f34fef3f380d88&_e=58RQW9xuxOMsjPnZ_d0HNYRFZeZG4Ufqk6Jcug-dVBtckPyqEbw5XhYigasOkAzdaFNzACM_-ySSpKRtkLR678m5BnH2QiuKI-6Dy5vGQYWI88kipXa9GLxqWLXp7PlZWnkHGQhgWThJBzHbCGMAqmBcILe8X0h-6_y6lX08MXyYxTnbWQgD2umMzjHV1vvG8PtsqKUynORg2Z71A9U_3K6NY9hE4Vgg6EcqX8C_9yTTXAu_MOH0dlWgov9muO-k4dTiOYH2t3VfDuwlcaBdL6DDeyJCqmsF74Q95Uo7YjKvPKd0EbB7HVFgpeWapZUURqEblVIJ3vCitU0jzuBO3-86SABTUj42vFtxfxlvW_etSmocw9i9RWdfYHWK0LUhG5AUR1ouwGCUsUYDKVyZ1zqBzMetnhXuB-qqytF6kk77BiXeYseYu_fuRJCh0Fdm)

If Ilhan Omar wants to protect Somalia's sea rather than America's border, I'd be more than happy to fund her plane ticket back to Somalia after I beat her in November. [**Chip in now to help me.**](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=96119dd4d3af455383f34fef3f380d88&_e=58RQW9xuxOMsjPnZ_d0HNYRFZeZG4Ufqk6Jcug-dVBtckPyqEbw5XhYigasOkAzdaFNzACM_-ySSpKRtkLR678m5BnH2QiuKI-6Dy5vGQYWI88kipXa9GLxqWLXp7PlZWnkHGQhgWThJBzHbCGMAqmBcILe8X0h-6_y6lX08MXyYxTnbWQgD2umMzjHV1vvG8PtsqKUynORg2Z71A9U_3K6NY9hE4Vgg6EcqX8C_9yTTXAu_MOH0dlWgov9muO-k4dTiOYH2t3VfDuwlcaBdL8Ans92LgdzLiyT9ZIfqh_xO14E-SKwV7NR8pOr_PxBNsvTkOPY_csmhveEkG0faQeW7z1dCo82CP87tMqzPlVWHz-5jXZl0KzvZlGcqzNa6qiOYwwG0BKxj3ry36HNSzL3gI61YYBirBAC1PzocIUIHvp-uvZgDS4DgCxVKMRjt)

Ilhan Omar has made it clear time and time again that her allegiance lies with Somalia, Hamas, and other American-hating groups. Meanwhile, she disgraces the halls of Congress in Washington, D.C., every day by aligning herself with the Squad and the most Radical factions of the Radical Left. I've had enough, and so have the people of Minnesota-05. It's time to expel her from Congress, and that starts with winning this election on November 5. But Ilhan Omar has the backing of the Squad and the Deep State Democrats' millions of dollars. The only way we can win is with a strong, nationwide grassroots Conservative effort. That's why I'm setting a goal to collect just 50 donations by midnight tonight. No donation is too small (or large) to make a difference in this race. If Ilhan Omar wants to protect Somalia's sea rather than America's border, I'd be more than happy to fund her plane ticket back to Somalia after I beat her in November. God Bless America, Dalia Al-Aqidi Candidate for Minnesota's 5th Congressional District | Paid for by Dalia for Congress.

Peter,

I couldn’t agree more.

As a mom and a candidate for Congress, I know firsthand the challenges of finding affordable childcare. In fact, most of my student loans are the result of costs associated with finding childcare for my two girls. It's an issue that affects families across Michigan, and it's one we can't afford to ignore.

**Did you know that Michigan is losing an estimated $2.88 billion in annual economic activity, including $576 million in direct revenue, due to inaccessible and unaffordable childcare?**

Affordable childcare is essential for our families and our economy. It allows parents to work, pursue education, and contribute to our communities. When childcare is out of reach, it holds us all back.

I’m committed to helping families and kids in Congress. We need policies that support working families, make quality childcare accessible, and invest in our children's future.

### ****Statement from Tad Jude Regarding the Case of State vs. Minnesota Trooper Ryan Londregan** : **
---
Most of our citizens are aware of the recent case involving Minnesota state Trooper Ryan Londregan.

He was on duty a year ago when he and two fellow troopers conducted a traffic stop of Ricky Cobb II. Cobb attempted to flee the stop while one of the Troopers, Brett Seide, had half his body in the driver’s side window. Fearing for his fellow Trooper’s life and his own, Londregan fired on Cobb, killing him.

Londregan was charged with second degree murder by Hennepin County Attorney Mary Moriarty. Moriarty shirked her duty to exercise good sense and judgment that comes with the responsibility of her office.

The failure of Attorney Moriarty to impartially view evidence and make a common sense decision resulted in the case being outsourced for investigation by a Washington, D.C. law firm.

This fact not only represents appalling negligence on the part of Moriarty, it also added a completely unnecessary and enormous expense, specifically $578,321, to taxpayers.

Almost without doubt, Moriarty knew very early on in the investigation that a case for prosecution of Londregan was not supported by the facts, and it was even clear her own internal use-of-force expert who examined this case indicated that Londregan’s actions were likely justified.

We pay public officials for their expertise and willingness to put their professional reputations on the line.

This is an example of County Attorney Moriarity putting politics before justice.

The firm hired by Moriarty concluded in a report that the prosecutor did not have evidence that contradicted defense claims that the use of force was justified.

All of us understand the use of force is not a frivolous action, Trooper Londregan understands that, too. By prolonging this investigation over the course of year, the lives of Londregan, his family, fellow troopers, and the family of Ricky Cobb, who were so obviously misled into thinking a crime took place, were horribly disrupted.

As a candidate for Minnesota’s 3rd Congressional district, and as a former Judge, I want to apologize to Ryan Londregan for the gross mishandling of his case. The taxpayers deserve an apology from the Hennepin County Attorney.

Fortunately, justice eventually prevailed.
|

---

**I’VE WON** in both Hennepin and Anoka Counties and I’ve door-knocked over 100,000 doors in this district. I **know** this district.

body:

clean_body: I won’t sit back and allow Big Oil to get away with their lies and greed.| | | Friend, FIRST:** Big Oil spent decades lying to the public about the impacts of climate change. Year over year, executives for corporations like ExxonMobile and Chevron have raked in billions of dollars in profits at the expense of our planet. THEN:**** As the chair of the Subcommittee on the Environment, we brought Big Oil executives to testify before Congress in 2021 and began to hold them accountable for their role in accelerating the effects of climate change. NOW:**** I’m being attacked by Big Oil for putting people and the environment before their bottom line. = = | | Since joining the House of Representatives, I have fought tirelessly to hold Big Oil accountable for exploiting hardworking Americans and fueling the climate crisis: I introduced legislation to block Big Oil subsidies, which would repeal a policy providing fossil fuel companies billions of dollars in tax credits for more pollution, more oil and gas production, and more greenhouse gas emissions. When Big Oil capitalized on the energy crisis to rake in record profits while Americans faced the highest gas prices seen since 2008, I introduced the Big Oil Windfall Profits Tax, legislation that would incentivize capping gas prices and return these corporations’ excess profits to consumers through a quarterly rebate. I won’t sit back and allow Big Oil to get away with their lies and greed. =** = = = = = = Thank you for your support, your activism, and all that you do. Friends,
Yesterday, I was asked by the press: "What do you think is the most pressing issue in the First Congressional District, and how would you, if elected, use your position in Congress to rectify it?"
As you might know, I'm not one for short sound bites. I don't partake in meaningless rhetoric or platitudes. So, it prompted me to write this. [https://www.votedrbob.com/post/my-vision-for-northern-michigan-the-up-bob-lorinser-for-congress]

When I'm sending e-mails, I'm only talking to about 10% of the voter base.
Today, my only ask is for you to share this post. You can forward this e-mail to your network or it will be on top of our social media pages all day.
Thank you for your support.
Election Day is in 5 days!
-Dr. Bob

Happy Colorado Day! It’s a beautiful day to hike one of Colorado’s many trails, one of my favorite summer activities.

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kaine for Virginia
body:

To all my friends, family, longtime team members, and newer supporters:
I want to thank you from the bottom of my heart for the way you stepped up to support my re-election campaign throughout July. It was one of the most momentous months in American political history, and throughout it all, you were there.
We saw more than 17,000 (!) online contributions — the most we’ve ever gotten in one month, leading to the strongest online fundraising month in any campaign I’ve ever run! And that’s going to make a meaningful difference in what we’re able to accomplish on the ground. When we’re able to build up more resources, we’re able to hire more organizers, recruit more volunteers, run more GOTV ads, and mobilize more voters to the polls.
In an election year that is the most consequential of our lifetimes — with incredibly high stakes, with our foundational rights on the ballot, and with the opportunity to elect the first Black woman as President of the United States — every single dollar matters.
So thank you — grassroots donors are truly the backbone of any winning campaign, and I’m so grateful to have this team by my side!
We may have an uphill battle between now and November, but with your help, we’re going to send Kamala Harris to the White House, hold onto my U.S. Senate seat, and flip the House.
Thanks again,
Tim Kaine

name: Jamaal Bowman
subject: It’s time for the people to fight back
body:
We have less than one week to protect Cori’s House seat in MO-01.
#
Peter,
AIPAC and their right-wing megadonor-funded super PAC spent over $20 million — the most money spent on a House primary in U.S. history — to replace me with a corporate, corrupt moderate last June. We can’t let the same thing happen to my sister in justice, Rep. Cori Bush.
**Cori’s primary is rapidly approaching in less than one week, and she’s facing the same dark money attacks from the GOP millionaires and billionaires backing her faux-progressive opponent. They’ve already spent more than $12 million against her across the district, so it’s on us to stand up and say St. Louis is not for sale.**
**[Will you rush a grassroots contribution of any amount split between Cori’s campaign and Justice Democrats to help them fight back?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240801-1-cb.OgsRGV&refcode=em20240801-35856&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=2&akid=35856%2E1203867%2E8TG8ee)**
Cori is a progressive champion in so many ways, from holding a sit-in on the steps of the U.S. Capitol to extend the eviction moratorium to being one of the first to call for a ceasefire in Gaza. But she’s also leading the fight for reproductive justice.
**Her opponent, a former campaign manager for an anti-abortion extremist, continues to try and sell St. Louis to GOP funders.** With abortion, birth control, and IVF under attack by far-right Republicans, especially in Missouri, we can’t afford to lose Cori’s fierce dedication to reproductive freedom in Congress at a time like this.
**[It's time for the people to fight back and show groups like AIPAC they can’t buy our Democratic elections. Help get out the vote for Cori in these final five days before her competitive primary by supporting her campaign and Justice Democrats now!](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240801-1-cb.OgsRGV&refcode=em20240801-35856&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=3&akid=35856%2E1203867%2E8TG8ee)**
**[Contribute $5](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240801-1-cb.OgsRGV&refcode=em20240801-35856&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=22&akid=35856%2E1203867%2E8TG8ee)**
It’s been an honor to work alongside Cori in Congress, so I hope you’ll pitch in to help our grassroots movement overcome the obstacles and send her back to Washington to keep fighting for the people.
Peace and love,
Jamaal

clean_body: We have less than one week to protect Cori’s House seat in MO-01. Peter, AIPAC and their right-wing megadonor-funded super PAC spent over $20 million — the most money spent on a House primary in U.S. history — to replace me with a corporate, corrupt moderate last June. We can’t let the same thing happen to my sister in justice, Rep. Cori Bush. Cori’s primary is rapidly approaching in less than one week, and she’s facing the same dark money attacks from the GOP millionaires and billionaires backing her faux-progressive opponent. They’ve already spent more than $12 million against her across the district, so it’s on us to stand up and say St. Louis is not for sale. Cori is a progressive champion in so many ways, from holding a sit-in on the steps of the U.S. Capitol to extend the eviction moratorium to being one of the first to call for a ceasefire in Gaza. But she’s also leading the fight for reproductive justice. Her opponent, a former campaign manager for an anti-abortion extremist, continues to try and sell St. Louis to GOP funders. With abortion, birth control, and IVF under attack by far-right Republicans, especially in Missouri, we can’t afford to lose Cori’s fierce dedication to reproductive freedom in Congress at a time like this. It’s been an honor to work alongside Cori in Congress, so I hope you’ll pitch in to help our grassroots movement overcome the obstacles and send her back to Washington to keep fighting for the people. Peace and love, Jamaal Not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. But through all the turmoil, we cannot forget about the things that ground us or the values that unite us. Family, faith, and community Those were and still are the exact reasons why I got into this race, and I remain more committed than ever to fighting for our shared values.
Amidst this turbulence, our campaign has been working tirelessly. We’ve been out in full force this month, knocking on doors, attending events, and meeting with voters across our district.

Hi there Peter, it's Joe.
CA-40 made me the man I am today.
Don’t believe me? Well, in honor of Throwback Thursday, I want to take you on a walk down memory lane. Keep scrolling to see some photos of decades past but, before you do, will you chip in $10, $20, or $30 to my campaign, so we can build a better future for CA-40? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftjoekerr?refcode=x_080124_throwbackthursday]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftjoekerr?refcode=x_080124_throwbackthursday [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftjoekerr?refcode=x_080124_throwbackthursday]
Even before I could grow a stache, I knew I wanted to serve my community, just like my father did before me.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftjoekerr?refcode=x_080124_throwbackthursday [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftjoekerr?refcode=x_080124_throwbackthursday]
I never imagined that this kid would be elected as the first President of the Orange County Professional Firefighters Association and hold that position for 17 years.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftjoekerr?refcode=x_080124_throwbackthursday [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftjoekerr?refcode=x_080124_throwbackthursday]
Or that my brothers and sisters on the frontlines would trust me as their Vice President of the California Professional Firefighters and a Vice President of the Orange County Central Labor Council (AFL-CIO).
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftjoekerr?refcode=x_080124_throwbackthursday [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftjoekerr?refcode=x_080124_throwbackthursday]
CA-40 taught me how to be a teammate, and then, a leader. I learned how to advocate for my family, friends, and fellow firefighters.
I helped get over 200 bills and initiatives passed and signed into law by five governors and two presidents. These bills and initiatives offered solutions to public safety, climate change, and policies to help working people.
When firefighters and first responders needed a new healthcare system, I created one that reduced costs, increased benefits, and didn’t raise a penny in taxes.
I hear you and want to represent you because I am one of you.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftjoekerr?refcode=x_080124_throwbackthursday [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftjoekerr?refcode=x_080124_throwbackthursday]
And this July, I celebrated my 27th wedding anniversary with the love of my life, China, without whom I could not have done any of this.

body:
Are We Really Weird? I found it very interesting to read an opinion piece from S.E. Cupp labeling J.D. Vance, Sen. John Kennedy and myself as "weird.
| | [](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=13983928.7244.1.933ce3df6ad294741ae17f45b69f46f8) |

## Are We Really Weird?
---
I found it very interesting to read an _[opinion piece](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=13983928.7245.1.f7d4e83202692a24087bd4100ee86140)_ from **S.E. Cupp** labeling **J.D. Vance** , **Sen. John Kennedy** and **myself** as "**weird**." **The reasons we are considered weird:** -We think Drag Queen Story Time w/kids is **WEIRD** -We think Men boxing Women in the Olympics is **WEIRD** -We think Illegals being treated better than Veterans is **WEIRD** -We think defending Terrorist Organizations like Hamas is **WEIRD** -We think killing babies in their mother's womb is **WEIRD** I don't know about you but I guess I am weird for my _counter-culture beliefs_. I also wear it as a badge of honor for someone like **S.E. Cupp** to label me as "weird." In this world as Christians we are not meant to fit in. _We are different so that we can make a difference._ It is so important that we do not shy away from those things that world says makes us "weird." What the world calls "weird", God calls **Righteous** and **True**. Stand Strong in Christ! # The Primary Election is Next Tuesday!
---
|
## _Be Sure to Cast Your Vote by Aug 6_
---
| | | | | | | | | | | This coming Tuesday is the Primary election! The deadline for turning in your ballot, and voting in person, is Tuesday, August 6.
It is essential that everyone vote in the Primary — a strong showing will give us the momentum we need to take on Sen. Cantwell and defeat her in November!
---
| [](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=3ddb391b32&e=3ed3552a03)
---
|
### _Important Voting Info:_
---
|
* Ballots must by postmarked by Aug 6.

* You can also deposit your ballot in an [official drop box](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=89beb800e6&e=3ed3552a03) by 8pm Aug 6.

* You can register to vote, update your voter info, and vote, in person, at a [voting center](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=40179e7391&e=3ed3552a03) by 8pm Aug 6.

* Map of drop boxes & voting center locations is here: [https://www.sos.wa.gov/elections/voters/voter-registration/drop-box-and-voting-center-locations](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=bf264a71c4&e=3ed3552a03)

* Voter information is here: [https://www.sos.wa.gov/elections](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=b575bcbfd6&e=3ed3552a03)

---
|
---
|
# Rally in Spokane Tomorrow!
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
| | Come and join us for a pre-Primary rally in Spokane tomorrow, Friday August 2, with Dr Garcia, Gubernatorial candidate Dave Reichert and AG candidate Pete Serrano.
It starts at 5:30PM at the [Warehouse Athletic Facility, 800 N Hamilton St](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=ec88dbf6d0&e=3ed3552a03). Hope to see you there!

---
|
---
|
# Why We Need New Leadership in the U.S. Senate:
---
|
## _Rising Crime in Washington_
---
| The top concern of Washington voters is crime, and for good reason: Washington has been ranked the eighth most dangerous state in the nation.
A recent study, as reported in the [Tacoma News Tribune](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=b45ccd0485&e=3ed3552a03), _“analyzed crime data from the FBI and National Incident-Based Reporting System (NIBRS) and evaluated ten specific crime categories in order to find the 10 safest states and the 10 most dangerous states in the country. The study found that Washington was among the most dangerous states in America.”_
---
|
### _Violent Crime in WA Way Up_
---
| | | | | | | | | | | And there’s more bad news on crime in our state: While the national violent crime rate dipped slightly from 2020 to 2022, Washington’s violent crime rate rose by a staggering 81.9%.
It should be all hands on deck to work on solving our state’s crime crisis — including at the federal level. Unfortunately, as on so many other issues, Sen. Maria Cantwell is doing very little to punish criminals and protect our communities. As your next U.S. Senator, I’ll do more than issue press releases: I’ll work across party lines to get our crime rate down.
---
|
---
|
---
|
# YOU Can Help Make Our State Better
---
| On crime, the fentanyl crisis, inflation, and more, our state has gotten on the wrong track. But there’s something you can do to make a better future for Washington: [Contribute to our campaign — $5, $10, $25, or whatever you can give — so we can send Sen. Cantwell home and bring new leadership to our state](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=23130263ca&e=3ed3552a03).
We are so grateful and thankful for your support! Together, we can put Washington back on the right path.
---
[DONATE](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=0fb586af16&e=3ed3552a03)
|

Here’s the deal, Fellow American.

I’m a straight shooter – always have been always will. You might not like what I have to say but I will _never_ sugarcoat the truth. _Trust me, we deal with that enough in Washington._

So, here’s the God-honest truth: **Republicans will lose in November if we don’t start acting like a team.**

**We’ll lose the House, and truly, I don’t think we can handle a single day of total Democrat control in Washington.**

What Democrats want to do to America is clinically insane – _they want to change our foundations, to make our country unrecognizable. They are wasting all of your hard-earned money to fund illegal immigrants, higher prices, defunding the police, forcing parents out of the classroom, and lining their own pockets._

You might be burnt out from the constant stream of news out of Washington, trust me I get it... but if you want things to actually change for the better, _**you have to pay attention.**_

Dear Peter,
**This is it—we are in the final 100 days before Election Day.**
Kennedy's independent presidential campaign is gaining momentum, and we have a real chance to [unite our country](https://www.kennedy24.com/unite-america-video?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=100_days_vol_8_1_24&n=3) around his message.
But we can't do it without YOU!
[Volunteer Now](https://www.kennedy24.com/volunteer?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=100_days_vol_8_1_24&n=4)
You’ve supported the campaign in many ways, and now we need you more than ever. These last 100 days are crucial, and your involvement can make all the difference.
**Here’s how you can help:**
* **Phone Banking:** Help us reach out to supporters and voters. Your voice can recruit more volunteers, persuade undecided voters and mobilize our base.
* **Canvassing:** Hit the streets and engage with your community. Face-to-face conversations are powerful and effective.
* **Social Media Advocacy:** Use your online presence to amplify the Team Kennedy message. Share posts, create content, and engage with our supporters.
* **Tabling at Events:** Help organize a Kennedy campaign presence at large events.

[Volunteer Now](https://www.kennedy24.com/volunteer?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=100_days_vol_8_1_24&n=5)
Every hour you contribute brings us one step closer to victory and a unified nation. Imagine looking back and knowing you played a pivotal role in this historic campaign.
**We have fewer than 100 days to make a difference.** [Let’s make them count.](https://www.kennedy24.com/volunteer?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=100_days_vol_8_1_24&n=6)

Thank you for your unwavering support. Together, we can achieve something truly extraordinary.
Can’t wait to see you out there on the trail!
Team Kennedy

Folks, I’ll cut to the chase.

I’ve been in politics for a long time, and it’s clear to me that the North Carolina governor’s race is one of the most competitive and consequential elections of 2024. [**Josh Stein needs your help – can I count on you to chip in a split donation between his campaign and DASS PAC to help him win this toss-up race?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90024275/489174346/1667963535?refcode=em-8.1.24-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTkxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MDk1Njc3ZS0yNzUwLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=w_VNIO_VkgwFbVMb5BTUGFDFRd3_gcE8k-LkIj2e5UE=)

Josh Stein is a leader and a public servant. But right now, he’s up against Mark Robinson who is a proven conspiracy theorist and far-right extremist with a history of intolerance.

Robinson has called LGBTQ+ folks “filth” and claimed that the Holocaust was “hogwash.” This guy is one of the most extreme statewide-elected Republicans in the country – and yet the latest polls show him statistically TIED with Josh.

Look, if I know one thing it’s this: Defeating extremism is _never_ easy but it’s always necessary.

We know Democrats can win in North Carolina. Josh successfully won statewide – not once, but twice – in a state Trump carried.

Black Americans have long faced _far too many_ obstacles like discrimination, lower pay, and higher job instability – not to mention the racist voter suppression laws that Texas Republicans like Ted Cruz have championed, which make it harder for certain folks to vote.

**The bottom line is this: It's essential that our government reflects the people it represents.**

But unlike Ted Cruz, I don't have corporate special interests footing the bill for my campaign. | = Peter, I'm running to defeat Ted Cruz and become the first-ever Black Senator from Texas. If you’re already with me, = | = All the way back in 1870, Hiram Rhodes Revels, a pastor and State Senator from Mississippi was elected as the first Black US Senator. Since then, we've come a long way as a country. But representation – like our democracy – is a work in progress, and I believe we can do better. Black Americans have long faced far too many obstacles like discrimination, lower pay, and higher job instability – not to mention the racist voter suppression laws that Texas Republicans like Ted Cruz have championed, which make it harder for certain folks to vote. The bottom line is this: It's essential that our government reflects the people it represents. I'm ready to defeat Ted Cruz this November and fight to build a more perfect union for my boys and every kid in Texas. But unlike Ted Cruz, I don't have corporate special interests footing the bill for my campaign. I speak out strongly for all female athletes like me who’ve been forced to compete against men.
| Friend, I’m Riley Gaines. You may have heard my name in the news. I’m an All-American swimmer -- but I’m better known for my role in the fight to save women’s sports.
Women and girls have a right to compete fairly, and to private locker rooms. I speak out strongly for all female athletes like me who’ve been forced to compete against men. **Just this year, a female golfer lost her spot in the U.S. Women’s Open qualifier at Bradenton to a man, James “Hailey” Davidson.** Then, USA Today _took down_ a brilliant op-ed by Republican Senator John Kennedy. In the op-ed, he demanded to know if “inclusion” should be prioritized over fairness and safety when it comes to sports. But Friend, I won’t be censored! Instead, I seek to build a community of thousands of sensible Americans who know the difference between a man and a woman. I started the Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute so that women would have a place to speak out against the gender ideology radicals. name: Scott Baugh
subject: July Wrap-Up
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Scott Baugh for Congress
body:
|
---
| |
---
|
---
| Peter, What a month! July has been buzzing with energy and action as we’ve been knocking on several thousand of doors each week, connecting with our incredible community. The enthusiasm is electric, and it’s truly inspiring to see so many people stepping up and getting involved. Every effort, every conversation, and every action is a testament to our united drive to support our families and shape our future. Thank you to everyone joining us this month to make a difference. Together, we’re not just making noise; we’re making waves of positive change. Let’s keep riding this wave of enthusiasm into August!
---
| |
---
**I celebrated the 4th with 50,000 of my closest friends! What a great day and an incredible outpouring of patriotism throughout the district. Thank you to everyone for the birthday wishes throughout the day!**
|
---
**Every single day our team is out knocking, talking to several thousands of voters every week, about the issues that matter to them. Thank you to everyone who has supported our efforts along the way! Our communities are ready for real change, and with the incredible candidates we are supporting, we’re on the brink of something remarkable. We have a ways to go still, but we will deliver that change because of you.**
|
---
**As the Chairman of Orange County’s Gang Reduction and Intervention Partnership (GRIP), it was an honor to attend the opening ceremonies of the 32nd Annual National Gang Violence Conference, hosted by the California Investigators Association, right here in Orange County. Our OC District Attorney, Todd Spitzer, and our OC Sheriff, Don Barnes, are doing a tremendous job keeping our community safe and holding criminals accountable. Their leadership starkly contrasts the challenges faced by neighboring areas like LA, where rising crime affects our communities too. In Congress, I will be a leader supporting law enforcement and promoting law and order at all levels. Sheriff Barnes highlighted my role in OC GRIP, a program I’m incredibly honored to support that helps our youth stay on the right track. Supporting such impactful work is truly fulfilling!**
|
---
**Costa Mesa is an incredible community that deserves strong leadership on the local, state, and federal level. Thank you Michael Buley for hosting a great event! If you live in Costa Mesa, we encourage you to vote for Michael Buley for District 1 City Council, Jeff Pettis for District 6, James Peters for Mayor, and Dr. Steven Choi for State Senate.**
|
---
**What an energizing evening at the Newport Harbor Republican Women Summer Social! It was truly incredible to see our community come together, bringing people from diverse backgrounds and lived experiences into a space of unity and patriotism. A big thank you to our wonderful hosts and the Newport Harbor Republican Women for organizing such an incredible event. Let’s continue working towards a stronger future for every American.**
|
---
**I had a fantastic time at “Coffee in the Park with Park!” My great friend John Park, who’s running for Irvine City Council, District 1, always knows how to bring the community together. John Park is the leader to protect Irvine communities! From the youngest to the wisest among us, it was a gathering that truly spanned generations. And yes, we even had a little guest named America- how fitting, especially since I was born on the 4th of July! Let’s keep the momentum going and empower our city’s future for all ages!**
|
---
**Thank you to our wonderful hosts for opening their home for an incredible event! Surrounded by devoted Americans and true patriots, we discussed the future of our country with optimism and resolve. Together, we will continue to champion and protect the values that make America exceptional.**
|
---
**I had a fantastic time at our recent event in Corona Del Mar! A huge thanks to our gracious hosts for opening their home. We dove into critical issues like crime, inflation, and the border while discussing the importance of our upcoming election and the need to stay engaged. It was wonderful meeting so many great people and connecting on these vital topics. Let’s keep the momentum going and make our voices heard!**
|
---
**A great showing in Seal Beach! Thank you to everyone who came out to support our campaign, and a special thank you to our wonderful hosts. In Congress, I will protect the values that make Seal Beach a special community**
|
---
**What an incredible turnout in Irvine! Our BBQ was a hit, and I had the pleasure of engaging in wonderful conversations with so many of you. It’s clear that people want more than just the basics - they’re aiming for the ability to save, invest in their children’s education, and enjoy a sense of security. Your voices are heard, and I’m committed to working for a future where these goals are within reach for everyone. Thank you for your support and for sharing your hopes with me.**

Montana is Big Sky country, and I'm convinced it's the ultimate expression of God's second day of creation. The beauty of Montana is breathtaking, but more important than what can be seen, is what is unseen. Peter, Chuck Hubbard here again. I’ve spent basically my whole life working as a local journalist and newspaper publisher. I was born and raised in this industry — my grandfather founded the Wilkes Journal-Patriot in 1932 in an effort to establish a reliable local news source for our small mountain community, and it’s been a family business ever since. At age eight, I started out stacking newspapers in the printing room. By sixteen, I was reporting for the paper full time as a high school student. And after graduating from college, I went right back to work for the paper. I knew that my calling was connecting the folks in our community with the news that mattered to them, and I was eager to fulfill that purpose. **With over forty years in journalism, I never let my political beliefs influence my reporting. I’ve had hard words for Democrats and Republicans alike, I’ve always been honest with folks, and I’ve made sure to tell the truth no matter what was at stake.** _**That’s because I took pride in my work, and I**** _always_****wanted to make sure that I was putting the people I served at the paper before my own beliefs and ambitions.**_ With her nearly thirty years in politics, I just wish Virginia Foxx could say the same. **But over the last few decades, I’ve watched her rise to power—all of it—from my home in Wilkes County, and with every race she's won, the real losers have been our people here in the High Country.** Virginia Foxx would rather work to ban abortion nationwide, remove protections for our LGBTQ+ youth and attack our public education system than raise wages, support our small businesses and provide for our communities that are struggling. She’s consistently one of the first Republicans out the gate to dismantle the very programs that allowed them to succeed — public schools, workforce protections, investments in our communities, and equal opportunity for all. They’re pulling up the ladder behind them, and I just can’t sit by and watch it from the sidelines anymore. **[I refuse to stand by any longer while Virginia Foxx and her Republican colleagues attack vulnerable communities and women’s rights to earn political points. That’s why I stepped up to run against her — but I need your support to help flip this district! Can you chip in any amount today to support our efforts?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90028469/489186718/6659627?refcode=onboarding.2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc3NDgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWNhODdhYWItMmQ1MC1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=tMEJvaCl3HQOF7xz74zzffLIRLGKn4MDxEAYXk-KDPg=)**

Hey, it's Tulsi Gabbard.

You might have heard - I left the Democrat Party.

I could no longer associate myself with the elitist cabal of "woke" warmongers led by Hillary Clinton, Joe Biden, and Kamala Harris. _**[In fact, I *literally* just wrote the book on why I left the Party that is:](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=70c0002ef1bf48e8875c1f5d574eea68&_e=YxWZMD6bpGP_OuCAh3wlna2FHYKoVMyhJvwvV_kXj4zErO6sO-Y7boDU9hxku0VL1kxhqzmlHo_iFrz0h_hBkD67utRP2Xg1LsZjwfylDSfxL51U8hRvyv1rlkM0kdrZUB4BdjgFefifNqul_ebASOmLesSJxwNa71vMb_DcpcL4b-CqxQkttqZtl__jvCx0kWDzxD3WopLtLe1TSp9lN1qetBU5BHLf3qNHJ2S5KJqwIg78xl7pDzVx272kV3vuraTGZ-uK0oGqe3C_MUEdzki5e02pTPCmZzBC0GkCzYzpjFAF_kARwlwi0g2s9aXrLsz41Ofgzd4IcpAo7Gq11s7UvHiY8LbZSTEuBVKN1_xEd7Id_5u1o3uBtwd4srt7GABLnUqjQhHd0wrtXDm6ug%3D%3D "In fact, I *literally* just wrote the book on why I left the Party that is: ")**_** **

- Weaponizing our own government against us
- Gutting the Second Amendment
- Erasing women and threatening fairness in women's sports
- Supporting the mutilation of children's bodies in the name of "gender affirming care"
- Censoring voices they do not approve of
- Enabling cartels and supporting illegal immigration
- Targeting people of faith and spirituality
- Pushing us toward WWIII and nuclear Armageddon
- Undermining free-speech

**The Democrat Party I joined over 20 years ago is dead and gone. **And the shell standing in its place is controlled by the most extreme power-hungry Democrat politicians and groups in America.

_**[I'm partnering with Steve Scalise for the FIRST TIME because our freedom and the future of our country hangs in the balance and we must do all we can to save it.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=70c0002ef1bf48e8875c1f5d574eea68&_e=YxWZMD6bpGP_OuCAh3wlna2FHYKoVMyhJvwvV_kXj4zErO6sO-Y7boDU9hxku0VL1kxhqzmlHo_iFrz0h_hBkD67utRP2Xg1LsZjwfylDSfxL51U8hRvyv1rlkM0kdrZUB4BdjgFefifNqul_ebASOmLesSJxwNa71vMb_DcpcL4b-CqxQkttqZtl__jvCx0kWDzxD3WopLtLe1TSp9lN1qetBU5BHLf3qNHJ2S5KJr9OPTyy7Rqm5Gq7-p3EDgwVtbS25qBJYWvP_TT-t0ytEyXwTJBQj09bw9X5LipXQCktuuAACmTpd7cEfz5oW4zlD6AjrDe8D7JYN8b-veuE-ychWMNadyT_YAa4_dk6dei3_-k0EBkvKOTKtWrI3hGUE9paTxyP3e_Nkgx_W5F-A%3D%3D "I’m partnering with Steve Scalise for the FIRST TIME because our freedom and the future of our country hangs in the balance and we must do all we can to save it.")**_

We set a goal of raising 100K dollars by the end of the day TODAY. It's a big goal but those who stand for freedom are being outspent 10 to 1 by a Democrat Party that is eviscerating our Constitution and freedoms before our very eyes. We need an OVERWHELMING response to defeat those who are abusing their power once and for all.

_So with everything on the line in 2024, are you willing to step up when we need you the most?_

body:
We are up against an entrenched incumbent... | | | | | |
---
| Hey Peter!

Shelane and the team are excited to have you on board as we strive to bring independent leadership to North Carolina's 9th Congressional District.

Shelane’s journey from a decorated Special Operations Soldier to a pioneering congressional candidate is fueled by a commitment to serve, a dedication to integrity, and an unyielding belief in the power of community and collaboration.

**An Independent Voice for Real Change

** Shelane is running for Congress to bring genuine leadership to Washington, untainted by party politics. She believes in putting people over politics, and her campaign is dedicated to serving all constituents, not just those who align with a particular party. Here’s what we stand for:
1. **Bridging Divides** : Shelane believes that true leaders unify rather than divide. Her experience as a Special Operations Soldier taught her the importance of teamwork and collaboration. She is committed to working across the aisle to find common ground and solutions that benefit everyone.

2. **Integrity in Leadership** : Leadership should be grounded in honesty, transparency, and accountability. Shelane's military career and her community work have always been marked by these values. She aims to bring the same level of integrity to Congress.

3. **Service Above Self** : Shelane’s life has been dedicated to serving others, from her deployments in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Syria, to her advocacy for veterans and community leaders. She believes that elected officials should prioritize the needs of their constituents over personal, corporate, or partisan interests.

4. **Empowering Communities** : Shelane is committed to empowering people to build peaceful and prosperous societies. This involves supporting policies that enhance education, healthcare, and economic opportunities for all. She believes that every individual deserves a fair shot at success.

5. **Defending Democracy** : Shelane recognizes that our democracy is struggling and requires fresh voices unburdened by partisan loyalties. She is dedicated to promoting key reforms that will restore faith in our democratic institutions and ensure that the government truly reflects the will of the people.

The road ahead is challenging, but with your support, we can bring a fresh voice to Congress and truly make a difference.

Thank you for being part of this journey. Together, we _will_ achieve great things.

In Solidarity,
Team Etchison

Peter,
In case you missed it, on Wednesday, Trump had a pretty difficult day. In a matter of 24 hours he:
* Made racist remarks at a conference for Black journalists, including questioning Kamala Harris’ race and calling the moderator “nasty” and “hostile.”
* At a Pennsylvania rally, he made a distasteful joke about Corey Comperatore, the first responder who died shielding his family from bullets during the attempt on Trump’s life.
* At the same rally, Trump introduced U.S. Senate candidate David McCormick as Pennsylvania’s “next Governor.”

It’s been painfully obvious for a long while that Donald Trump isn’t fit to be President. **So where are the calls from the legacy media for him to get out of the race?**
[**We’ll explain more in a moment, but if you’re ready to support COURIER’s mission to call out bias and hypocrisy in the media, can you chip in $20 now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90029746/489190700/-593472309?refcode=20240801-EM-TrumpMentalFitness&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTk5ZDI3ZGYtMmY1MC1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=e0mBzlxz32vEomKN7giBQweS_t1AqhV5xzEe9W5TVQI=)
The debate over Trump’s fitness for public office should have ended forever on January 6th, 2021. On that day, Trump incited a riot at the Capitol and tried to overturn the results of a free and fair election. In doing so, he became the first American President to not adhere to the peaceful transfer of power, a bedrock of American Democracy.
In the aftermath of January 6th, the media and many Republicans excoriated Trump for his actions. But, once it became clear that Trump was the nominee again, all of that went away.
**And then Joe Biden had a bad debate and, for a month, there was wall to wall coverage and speculation about when he would drop out. **
A lot of that coverage was around Biden’s verbal flubs and mental lapses. You know, the same kind of stuff we’ve seen over and over again from Trump on the campaign trail. Examples like:
* Calling President Biden “Obama” 8 times 🤔
* Warning that President Biden might get us into “World War II” 😳
* Repeatedly confusing Nikki Haley and Nancy Pelosi 🤨
* Falling asleep during his own criminal trial in New York 😴
* Giving multiple speeches where he slurs his words and sounds totally incoherent while speaking 🫠

**So, after yesterday, where are the calls to resign? Where are the editorial boards denouncing Trump’s campaign?**
With less than 100 days to go before Election Day, more and more Americans are turning to the news to make up their minds before heading to the polls. They deserve access to honest, unbiased reporting.
**And while the mainstream media will normalize Trump to drive profits and clicks, at COURIER, we do things differently.**
Our journalists in newsrooms across eleven battleground states are committed to finding the facts and telling the truth. We will never compromise our values just to drive clicks and buzz.
[**We’re fighting back against the mainstream media’s hypocrisy with fearless, fact-based coverage of the 2024 election in 11 battleground states across the country. In a matter of 24 hours he: Made racist remarks at a conference for Black journalists, including questioning Kamala Harris’ race and calling the moderator “nasty” and “hostile.” At a Pennsylvania rally, he made a distasteful joke about Corey Comperatore, the first responder who died shielding his family from bullets during the attempt on Trump’s life. In the aftermath of January 6th, the media and many Republicans excoriated Trump for his actions. But, once it became clear that Trump was the nominee again, all of that went away. subject: Why we just sold half of our stocks
body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.

Dear Reader,
We've already sold all or part of
52 different stocks this year - more than any other period in our
firms' history.
That's given us an average gain
of 50.56% on all closed trades so far this year, which is great.
But a lot of folks have written
in to ask why we've begun to position our portfolio so
defensively.
That's because there are five
cracks forming below this market that threaten us with a
widespread collapse unlike anything we've seen in our lifetime.
And I don't see how we stop these
cracks from continuing to weaken our foundation until we
collapse.
There's no stimulus package from
the government that is big enough...
No interest rate cut dramatic
enough...
And no tax cut deep enough to
prevent the inevitable.
The only thing you can do is
prepare for it.
In the end, we could see the
market tumble by 50%, real estate plummet by 40% and savings
accounts will lose 30% and unemployment will triple.
That's why I rushed to record
this new documentary for you explaining what I'm seeing... and
how you can prepare for it.
Because I don't think there's
much time left to prepare.
According to my calculations,
this collapse isn't coming in a year, six months or even three
months.
It began quietly on October 13,
2023.
See how to prepare for the coming
storm right here.
"The Buck Stops Here,"

For too long, Supreme Court justices have been accepting _substantial, unreported_ gifts from the rich and powerful — and they’ve been getting away with it.
Justice Clarence Thomas is the number one culprit. Thomas reportedly accepted millions of dollars’ worth of gifts over the past two decades! He’s been chauffeured around on billionaires’ private jets, taken lavish vacations aboard their yachts, and sat in their private suites at sporting events — all while he does their bidding on the bench.
But this isn’t the only time Clarence Thomas has been caught cozying up to billionaires who have business before the Court. In 2018, Thomas arrived on a private jet to attend an expensive dinner with Big Oil billionaire Charles Koch, his late brother David, and their network of wealthy right-wing donors at the Koch network’s annual winter donor summit.
**This was right as the Supreme Court prepared to hear a pivotal anti-environmental case _backed by the Koch network_ — one that would ultimately decide in their favor, overturn the _Chevron_ doctrine, and upend the bedrock precedent behind decades of environmental protections.**
This kind of blatant corruption is eroding the integrity of our judicial system and our democracy.
But there’s hope. **Representatives Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and Jamie Raskin are fighting back with legislation to ban these outrageous gifts and set strict limits.** This is a crucial step to holding Supreme Court justices to the same ethical standards as other federal officials and restoring integrity. But we need more voices to join the fight, and we need them now.

clean_body: It’s time to restore integrity to our highest court. | | 📝 | For too long, Supreme Court justices have been accepting substantial, unreported gifts from the rich and powerful — and they’ve been getting away with it. Justice Clarence Thomas is the number one culprit. Thomas reportedly accepted millions of dollars’ worth of gifts over the past two decades! He’s been chauffeured around on billionaires’ private jets, taken lavish vacations aboard their yachts, and sat in their private suites at sporting events — all while he does their bidding on the bench. But this isn’t the only time Clarence Thomas has been caught cozying up to billionaires who have business before the Court. In 2018, Thomas arrived on a private jet to attend an expensive dinner with Big Oil billionaire Charles Koch, his late brother David, and their network of wealthy right-wing donors at the Koch network’s annual winter donor summit. This was right as the Supreme Court prepared to hear a pivotal anti-environmental case backed by the Koch network — one that would ultimately decide in their favor, overturn the Chevron doctrine, and upend the bedrock precedent behind decades of environmental protections. This kind of blatant corruption is eroding the integrity of our judicial system and our democracy. But there’s hope. Representatives Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and Jamie Raskin are fighting back with legislation to ban these outrageous gifts and set strict limits. This is a crucial step to holding Supreme Court justices to the same ethical standards as other federal officials and restoring integrity. But we need more voices to join the fight, and we need them now. At the Jane Fonda Climate PAC, we are committed to holding powerful interests accountable and fighting for a sustainable future. The climate crisis is here, and we can’t afford to let fossil fuel giants buy their way into favorable rulings. They are already pouring millions into pro-fossil fuel candidates up and down the ballot. With the Supreme Court in their pocket, our fight against the climate crisis becomes even more challenging. Banning large gifts to Supreme Court justices is essential. We need to stop them from taking luxury vacations on private yachts of Big Oil profiteers while the world burns around us. With determination, The Jane Fonda Climate PAC Team | = | = = Follow along: | | ---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. Friend, **A Democratic-controlled Congress could make all the difference in a future President Harris administration.** But if Democrats fail to retake the House and hold the Senate, a Republican-controlled Congress could stifle her agenda with gridlock and dysfunction. [**Can I count on you to split a donation between Kamala Harris and Serve America in order to ensure a Democratic trifecta?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90031321/489195662/1528005921?refcode=240801&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNzA4MzE2My0zMTUwLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KkNa6p3S3XffSfI3A9U-1OxO04znQwb4t_HAwa_U0Vs=) Reproductive rights... economic growth... protecting Social Security... combating climate change... safeguarding our democracy... all of these priorities depend on Democratic wins up and down the ballot. # Breaking: Major Prisoner Swap Brings Home Americans
---
|
---
In a groundbreaking move, President Biden has announced a historic prisoner swap involving seven nations, marking the largest such exchange in decades. The deal has secured the release of Wall Street Journal reporter Evan Gershkovich, former U.S. Marine Paul Whelan, and Radio Free Europe journalist Alsu Kurmasheva from Russian custody. They, along with Vladimir Kara-Murza Jr., have been freed as part of a complex and unprecedented agreement. This extensive negotiation effort has not only brought these Americans back home but also resulted in the release of 16 prominent Russian opposition figures. The swap, which took place at Ankara's international airport, involved a fleet of seven planes transporting 24 prisoners from various countries, including the U.S., Germany, Poland, Slovenia, Norway, and Russia. President Biden hailed the deal as a significant diplomatic success, as the freed individuals will now reunite with their families. He, along with Vice President Kamala Harris, is set to greet the returning Americans at Joint Base Andrews in Maryland. In addition to the American prisoners, the swap saw the release of high-profile Russian political prisoners such as Ilya Yashin and Vladimir Kara-Murza, both well-known figures in Russia’s pro-democracy movement. The deal also included the release of several Germans and individuals from other European nations. While the agreement represents a major achievement in international diplomacy, it has sparked discussions about the implications for future negotiations and the broader context of international relations.

Here’s the God-honest truth: Republicans will lose in November if we don’t start acting like a team. |
[ ](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=32fe3c93d3284464ae4ea92b01ee5824&_e=muJeG_JBn43y_f78eZnMnjRjQoJX-fDxJlwDEdm9oKOsn4Y3EMXSyZHGj2Vh32h2TBqnEZDmM3t7AAaYu666gGaPj__SOaGmqDem8z6RoWCQfCNh-tf13L2h3RQ038Kbb44bGWiy4mu3A7kVtGVR1OfiwgMJfZypc1RkyEIs4ocqaZKIv3sopBYpS0NoyG5XcswnAMxOYLLZQMewWy3HMBGHFzJ-w4RY_D8ElGyUDBFaOZnYuyWNKq5oQGl-SWA5JE8ww-Z98Hj2NShj9Hrku3V87PEjlmq9Op3In7RRghcPYG-fmgc2f5Cknisd72xPSNOLsKDOtdObmW3dKoKnxN-tDD127Jmliz_QuCWINmGgKqoWQN4zsxPJzgKOemeZ5gAcCooARGY98d7FtsLJhd0QlhLkW8gy8ZR1aqTHxAoo9Jkp304gP6psTlBI-Sm8)

Here’s the deal, Peter.

I’m a straight shooter – always have been always will. You might not like what I have to say but I will _never_ sugarcoat the truth. _Trust me, we deal with that enough in Washington._

So, here’s the God-honest truth: **Republicans will lose in November if we don’t start acting like a team.**

**We’ll lose the House, and truly, I don’t think we can handle a single day of total Democrat control in Washington.**

What Democrats want to do to America is clinically insane – _they want to change our foundations, to make our country unrecognizable. They are wasting all of your hard-earned money to fund illegal immigrants, higher prices, defunding the police, forcing parents out of the classroom, and lining their own pockets._

You might be burnt out from the constant stream of news out of Washington, trust me I get it... but if you want things to actually change for the better, _**you have to pay attention.**_

[**We can’t sit back and take this way of life because if we do we’ll see Democrats take our country away.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=32fe3c93d3284464ae4ea92b01ee5824&_e=muJeG_JBn43y_f78eZnMnjRjQoJX-fDxJlwDEdm9oKOsn4Y3EMXSyZHGj2Vh32h2TBqnEZDmM3t7AAaYu666gGaPj__SOaGmqDem8z6RoWCQfCNh-tf13L2h3RQ038Kbb44bGWiy4mu3A7kVtGVR1OfiwgMJfZypc1RkyEIs4ocqaZKIv3sopBYpS0NoyG5XcswnAMxOYLLZQMewWy3HMBGHFzJ-w4RY_D8ElGyUDBFaOZnYuyWNKq5oQGl-SWA5JE8ww-Z98Hj2NShj9Hrku3V87PEjlmq9Op3In7RRgheIh7ki7MMt_LT9UOMlD4wOT3-EHEY1l7Uf9IS3Xo-Gti-vjry2qbjXP0e3upizhnbXk_xiC24nVqqTX339IAlAECnPSQcb2GhCp98sTSsOV-mkjvzq2dU6Xf_zIHv97bYm48zvVdKhbEKb9R0Kl00t)

[**I need to know you’re on the team who still cares about freedom._I need to know you are on the team who’s willing to stand up and FIGHT back against the woke mob that is infecting our country._**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=32fe3c93d3284464ae4ea92b01ee5824&_e=muJeG_JBn43y_f78eZnMnjRjQoJX-fDxJlwDEdm9oKOsn4Y3EMXSyZHGj2Vh32h2TBqnEZDmM3t7AAaYu666gGaPj__SOaGmqDem8z6RoWCQfCNh-tf13L2h3RQ038Kbb44bGWiy4mu3A7kVtGVR1OfiwgMJfZypc1RkyEIs4ocqaZKIv3sopBYpS0NoyG5XcswnAMxOYLLZQMewWy3HMBGHFzJ-w4RY_D8ElGyUDBFaOZnYuyWNKq5oQGl-SWA5JE8ww-Z98Hj2NShj9Hrku3V87PEjlmq9Op3In7RRghcf0D4-VhUANfHps26ttDFPCngoj-Q2lTNqpsMLWJX8iXSGwPRDpmhjyHjZ5iBm5JYO8lqZ_08TztzfVoB8WRnA_2eJhYfpsXG6RAmXU_I3Oi6mGs6LLbQvKvDroyCkeN9WrxaXF3EKD35PntBkypjK)

[** JOIN THE TEAM ➞ **](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=32fe3c93d3284464ae4ea92b01ee5824&_e=muJeG_JBn43y_f78eZnMnjRjQoJX-fDxJlwDEdm9oKOsn4Y3EMXSyZHGj2Vh32h2TBqnEZDmM3t7AAaYu666gGaPj__SOaGmqDem8z6RoWCQfCNh-tf13L2h3RQ038Kbb44bGWiy4mu3A7kVtGVR1OfiwgMJfZypc1RkyEIs4ocqaZKIv3sopBYpS0NoyG5XcswnAMxOYLLZQMewWy3HMBGHFzJ-w4RY_D8ElGyUDBFaOZnYuyWNKq5oQGl-SWA5JE8ww-Z98Hj2NShj9Hrku3V87PEjlmq9Op3In7RRghfU72WThd_-uDJ4qbPe1Doa6fVjkcAc6V_qY0iruw427eEfn3k3GLjl9eNYFbYrWE3IglihmbswWHil4xxmsjOb0SvN3qGjGYggE5rz1GIvYzebuQD3YyYGSGG_hc8fh5MglYSWhHRl0dVaScGPH6sT)

| | Dear Fellow American, Americans consistently rate Congress as one of the most unpopular branches of our government. But do you know how the "sausage is made" in the halls of the U.S. Congress? Here's a preview: It's a far cry from the _Schoolhouse Rock!_ song many of us learned as kids. We have to go back to how our Founding Fathers designed the U.S. Congress if we're going to understand this fully. Thankfully, Hillsdale College created our free online course, **" Congress: How It Worked and Why It Doesn't," **to do just that.** **
---

body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, August 1, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Harris’ long a supporter of an end to fracking flip-flops on policy in fight for voters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE WASHINGTON TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Once an advocate of a complete ban on fracking, Vice President Kamala Harris reversed course when she became the Democrats’ presumptive presidential nominee in an election that hinges on Pennsylvania voters.
Fracking, the extraction of natural gas and oil from bedrock, makes up a critical part of Pennsylvania’s economy, supporting more than 100,000 jobs in the state, according to a recent analysis.
Ms. Harris, who has embraced the Biden administration’s commitment to a net-zero electrical grid by 2035 and net-zero carbon emissions by 2050, has long supported an end to the fracking industry. She aligned herself with climate activists who are dedicated to ending fossil fuels and converting the nation’s energy to renewables such as solar and wind.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Since Monday morning, fires in Larimer, Boulder and Jefferson counties have forced thousands to flee their homes](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Four wildfires are currently burning in the foothills of Larimer, Boulder, and Jefferson counties, leading to thousands of evacuations.
* One fatality reported and five structures destroyed due to the fires. The largest fire, Alexander Mountain, has led to 3,200 property evacuations.
* Firefighters face near-record temperatures, low humidity, and strong winds, with stretched resources including support from the Colorado National Guard.
* Federal funding has been secured to cover 75% of firefighting costs for two of the fires.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[City council members raise doubts about Denver mayor’s housing plan](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER7 NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Denver City Council members are skeptical about Mayor Mike Johnston's proposal to raise the sales tax by 0.5% to fund affordable housing, citing potential impacts on working families and questioning long-term fund management.
* Council Member Stacie Gilmore highlighted that the proposed tax increase, combined with another approved tax, could significantly raise annual expenses for Denver households.
* Concerns persist about ensuring that the generated funds will be used effectively and reach those in greatest need.
* A working group has been formed to closely examine the proposal and address council members' concerns in hopes of refining it before a fall voter referendum.
* Some council members suggest delaying the vote to spring for more comprehensive stakeholder input and greater voter turnout, though the mayor's office stresses the urgency of addressing housing affordability now.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Ballot initiative aims to create new vet professional associate role to address shortage](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado's ballot initiative 145 seeks to introduce a "veterinary professional associate" (VPA) role, envisioned as a mid-level practitioner capable of performing certain surgeries, diagnosing conditions, and prescribing medicine under the supervision of a licensed veterinarian.
* The initiative aims to address the shortage in the veterinary workforce and improve access to veterinary care by adding more trained professionals who can provide high-quality, affordable services.
* While supported by entities like the Denver Dumb Friends League, which compares the role to physician assistants, the Colorado Veterinary Medical Association and other critics argue that the training, potentially online, is inadequate for the responsibilities, posing risks to animal care.
* To appear on the November ballot, the initiative needed at least 124,238 valid signatures, with nearly 200,000 reportedly submitted.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Despite expectations to the contrary, Fed holds interest rates steady](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE HILL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Jerome Powell indicated that the Federal Reserve might consider cutting interest rates as early as September if inflation continues to decrease and the job market remains stable.
* The Fed decided to keep rates steady at 5.25 to 5.5 percent, noting that although inflation has dropped from last year’s peak, it remained above 3 percent until recently dipping just below this level.
* Stock markets reacted positively to the news, with significant gains in anticipation of potential rate cuts by the Fed.
* Recent data shows a cooling labor market with a slight increase in the unemployment rate, alongside inflation rates that are beginning to align more closely with the Fed's targets.
* Powell emphasized the dual risks of persistent inflation and rising unemployment, stating that the Fed is carefully monitoring economic indicators to balance their dual mandate of stabilizing prices and minimizing unemployment.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Tremoglie: Kamala Harris needs to answer why she raised money to keep violent criminals out of jail](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [WASHINGTON EXAMINER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_What kind of presidential candidate raises money to keep violent criminals out of jail? It’s a question that Vice President Kamala Harris needs to answer._
_The current vice president, and the newly presumptive Democratic nominee, previously supported and helped raise money for an organization that sought to keep violent criminals on the streets free to wreak havoc, cause harm, and hurt innocent people. Think about that every time you hear her cackle. She smiled and laughed while every day, normal Americans were suffering._
_It’s important not to forget that Harris, who regularly mentions “protecting our democracy,” actively raised money to try to free rioters who burned down neighborhoods and looted stores during Black Lives Matter and antifa riots. These were people who actively tried to destroy our country and democracy. Yet these are the kind of people who Harris supported and actively worked to help escape punishment or accountability, as evidenced by her tweet on June 1, 2020._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****[Sloan: With Biden out and Harris in, don’t toll the victory bell just yet](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | JULY 30** _In the pantheon of political events, Joe Biden’s belated decision to become the first sitting President since Lyndon B. Johnson to not seek re-election was about as surprising as the advent of the sunrise at dawn._
______
**[‘We must protect our kids’: Lundberg calls for ‘all hands on deck’ to help get initiatives to the ballot](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | JULY 29** []() _The final days are winding down in an effort by Protect Kids Colorado to collect the signatures needed to get two initiatives on the fall ballot, former Sen. Kevin Lundberg wrote Monday in an email newsletter_
**_[House District 22 is now a three-candidate race in El Paso County](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | JULY 29** _A third candidate has joined the field in the Colorado House District 22 general election race. The signature petition of Daniel Campaña was certified last week by the secretary of state’s office. He submitted 1,253 signatures, of which 1,056 were accepted to clear the minimum requirement of 1,000 valid signatures_**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** __

Dear Fellow Believer,

Countless communities living in isolated parts of the world risk never hearing the gospel.

In these far-off places, not only are people cut off from knowing the good news of Jesus Christ, but they also lack access to essential resources like healthcare, education, and basic supplies.

When you make a gift to Mission Aviation Fellowship, you ensure that no matter the location, **no one is ever out of reach to receive the gospel.**

At Mission Aviation Fellowship (MAF), our airplanes can overcome these barriers of isolation. They are the lifelines that bring help, hope, and healing to the ends of the earth.

**But as a donor-funded ministry, these flights are possible through your support.**

When you give to MAF, your donation fuels our aircraft, equips our pilots, and ensures our planes are ready to respond at a moment's notice. Your support also provides training and resources for local missionaries, helping to spread the gospel even further.

Each flight sponsored by your generosity makes a difference. Whether it's delivering Bibles, transporting medical care, or providing relief supplies, your contribution directly impacts lives and brings the hope of Jesus to those in need.

Will you partner with us in this mission? Click the secure link below to make your gift:

[https://give.maf.org/s/give/da24](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=3b022ad94aa5497f9bb546491a2571e8&_e=JrWSAmPOwm1B_U9TwVh0iQ42UKPgF-IyXuf2aq5W09oS_tnULt60KVr1kXNqcLKsiPRRGqObQiKN7pnYnQsjEpMdW1UwckcmrW6ihanPe_s3iwzPQSYYZzr3rd0H_cO5CROqeXfofxFXfeVGPdJ82lkjxVWkvO8-6bFzB4xbOQDmhBaNqTD4VxQwYkWHpfL8iMgynVg_YTOTjQ7-RhmGGNNrJpvGwzuu4vJoZUzHIG1hbcFnyg_IGZUz0Uta2UmAVFoSeUPTUso8wfFqNgWnijYca-mJU_lXBnc6sFVwZJcaDJz98xGNPiFKvrUDnywVigojHDiM9G-yo2T-ECu9Gw%3D%3D)

Your donation can help us reach those who are otherwise unreachable--providing them with life-saving resources and the love of Christ.

Tracey Werre
Director of Marketing
Mission Aviation Fellowship

And why your $10 donation today could make such a big impact
#
Peter,
Before we ask you to **[make a donation of $10 toward our campaign to elect Lucas Kunce and replace Josh Hawley in the U.S. Senate,](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/64208?refcode=em20240801-7230&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7230%2E614464%2EgXorgF) here’s a quick overview of our race by the numbers:**
Josh Hawley has the lowest approval rating of any GOP U.S. Senator running in 2024. _Morning Consult_ reported that Hawley’s approval is just **44% — even lower than Republicans like Ted Cruz in Texas (48%) and Rick Scott in Florida (47%)**.
National insiders are growing worried about Hawley’s serious vulnerability. That’s why they funded a new Super PAC with more than **$1 MILLION** last year — and it’s why they’ve transferred millions of dollars directly to Josh Hawley’s campaign.
With your help, we’ve built a record-breaking grassroots movement to fight back and flip this Senate seat — raising **$2.8 million** in our last quarter, more than any Missouri challenger has ever raised at this point in an election cycle.
**Every $1 here in Missouri goes nearly 5 times as far as in states like Texas and Florida.** Our state’s smaller electorate and cheaper media markets mean we’ll be able to get Lucas’ message in front of voters early and often — online, on TV, and on the ground.
In Missouri’s last U.S. Senate race during a presidential election, there were about **230,000 split-ticket voters who supported a Democrat for Senate.** And with **94 days until Election Day,** we still have time to reach them with Lucas’ unifying vision for working people here in Missouri.
That’s why your **$10** donation today could make such a big impact.
But since **less than 1%** of folks reading this email will actually make a donation to our campaign, we’re counting on YOUR help, Peter.

## The Racism
Donald Trump spent his 34 minutes on stage at the National Association of Black Journalists reminding everyone just how racist he is. From the opening question, when journalist Rachel Scott read him his receipts of his extensive racist remarks over the years, Trump became defensive, angry, and lashed out--ultimately playing victim. He exemplified a text-book case of white fragility. That short 90 second exchange is worth the watch, as it set the tone for the rest of the debacle of an interview:
[](https://substack.com/redirect/700379e6-ce12-4b10-ac42-bbd69c0800fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
While Trump was scheduled to sit down for an hour long interview, he left after just 34 minutes. His handlers likely recognized he was only digging himself into a deeper hole and tried to cut their losses. But the damage was done. By the time it was over, Trump had accused media of being "fake news," a revival of the Hitler accusations of _L ugenpresse_ or "lying press," claimed he had done wonders for the Black community (he hasn't), and claimed Kamala Harris only just now started to identify as Black (she's always identified as Black). Trump spewed this lie:
> I didn't know she was Black until a number of years ago when she happened to turn Black and now she wants to be known as Black. So, I don't know, is she Indian or is she Black? I've known her a long time indirectly, not directly very much, and she was always of Indian heritage. I respect either one, but she obviously doesn't, because she was Indian all the way, and then all of a sudden she made a turn and she went - she became a Black person. I think somebody should look into that, too.
Not only is all of the above a lie, the fact that Trump wants Kamala Harris investigated for _also_ being Indian is authoritarian level racism. Adding to this absurd Trump stance is that Trump's own VP candidate JD Vance has mixed Indian children with his wife Usha Vance. [I've documented the grotesque racism she's facing for being Indian American](https://substack.com/redirect/5b267c55-ceff-48e5-a0df-0c41dcb5fdb3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). In short, what we're dealing with is a nakedly racist attempt to fear monger to a racist MAGA base that if you don't vote, a Black or Indian person who (allegedly) keeps changing their identity will be in charge.
And thus the hypocrisy.

Reflecting over MAGA's obsession with identity politics, I noticed a pattern and tweeted the following, [now viral tweet](https://substack.com/redirect/e38c180a-fa96-436a-9ab8-0541ed21f4f4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/773b580c-ae5c-4406-9642-2b748ce9ad35?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And it isn't only Republicans of color who keep changing their name for white approval. Who can forget that Donald Trump was originally Donald Drumpf? And JD Vance was initially James Donald Bowman and then later James David Hamel, before arriving at JD Vance? Even former RNC Chair Ronna McDaniel was originally Ronna Romney. Look, if people want to change their names--more power to them. My problem is the MAGA hypocrisy on full display to question the identities of people like Barack Obama and Kamala Harris--who proudly run on their names and identities--while themselves changing their own names and identities to appease a racist base.
Consider former Louisiana Republican Governor and GOP Presidential Candidate Bobby (Piyush) Jindal's favorite portrait versus how he actually looks. I swear the below image is not AI.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f27c3d6e-564a-4ae9-9e76-26178614332b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Bobby Jindal Piyush Jindal Photograph: Robin May/Getty Images
MAGA Republicans of color are literally whitewashing themselves for approval from a racist base that is openly hostile to them--yet have the audacity to question the identity of VP Kamala Harris. And making this situation even worse is the utter failure of legacy media to call out this racism and hold its actors accountable. Consider the headlines after Trump's racist rant at the NABJ.

## The Legacy Media Failure
The Washington Post's tagline is "Democracy Dies in Darkness," and I cannot figure out if this is a call to action to expose injustice, or a personal goal they're trying to achieve? Because in response to Donald Trump's grotesque racism targeting Kamala Harris, this was the Washington Post's headline:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/62e3dfa1-b683-45cc-85df-79ed6285d7c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The Boston Globe followed suit with their own flavor of racism:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dc513867-3b0c-4fa9-986a-5b87b620505d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And always one to enable racist messaging, the New York Times published this dud:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9ee1be01-7d4f-4147-a236-cc939617801f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In whitewashing Trump's racism and repeating his lies without qualification, the Boston Globe, the Washington Post, and the New York Times all proudly demonstrate how legacy media is failing to meet the moment. To recap, Trump engaged in grotesque racism, lies, and white supremacy -- and the Globe, the Post, and the Times framed his racism as some legitimate point of consideration, and worse, placed the burden of that racism on Harris, as if she is now answerable for Trump's racism. This is how democracy dies, in the darkness of misinformation and burden shifting.
Credit where due, I appreciated this most accurate headline by Mother Jones, because it well captures the absurdity of Trump's claims without excusing him one bit:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0577c959-8482-4749-be8b-5f97a02a745c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
